 425+ EA34 22 CA E0             ld (clip_src),hl
 426+ EA37 21 F5 FD             ld hl,clipB
 427+ EA3A 22 CC E0             ld (clip_dst),hl
 428+ EA3D 3E 80                ld a,$80
 429+ EA3F 32 C9 E0             ld (clip_plane),a               ; (a 2D plane)
 430+ EA42 21 DE E0             ld hl,c2_planes
 431+ EA45 3A DB E0     .pl:    ld a,(c2_or)
 432+ EA48 CB 3F                srl a
 433+ EA4A 32 DB E0             ld (c2_or),a
 434+ EA4D 30 16                jr nc,.skip
 435+ EA4F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 436+ EA50 32 DC E0             ld (c2_off),a
 437+ EA53 23                   inc hl
 438+ EA54 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 439+ EA55 32 DD E0             ld (c2_hi),a
 440+ EA58 2B                   dec hl
 441+ EA59 E5                   push hl
 442+ EA5A CD CA EC             call clip_poly
 443+ EA5D E1                   pop hl
 444+ EA5E 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 445+ EA61 FE 03                cp 3
 446+ EA63 38 2B                jr c,.none
 447+ EA65 23           .skip:  inc hl
 448+ EA66 23                   inc hl
 449+ EA67 3A DB E0             ld a,(c2_or)

 451+ EA6B 20 D8                jr nz,.pl

 454+ EA70 11 80 E0             ld de,p2buf
 455+ EA73 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 456+ EA76 32 E8 E0             ld (p2n),a
 457+ EA79 47                   ld b,a
 458+ EA7A 7E           .o:     ld a,(hl)                       ; x
 459+ EA7B 12                   ld (de),a
 460+ EA7C 13                   inc de
 461+ EA7D 23                   inc hl
 462+ EA7E 23                   inc hl

 467+ EA84 ED 31                add hl,a
 468+ EA86 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; edge flag

 471+ EA89 13                   inc de

 473+ EA8B 23                   inc hl
 474+ EA8C 10 EC                djnz .o

 478+ EA91 32 E8 E0             ld (p2n),a
 479+ EA94 C9                   ret

 481+ EA96 C1                   pop bc
 482+ EA97 37                   scf
 483+ EA98 C9                   ret
 484+ EA99
 485+ EA99              ; IX -> corner (X, Y, Z; Z >= NEAR) -> its screen x, y (16-bit) at IY+0, +2,
 486+ EA99              ; the screen planes it is outside ORed into c2_or.  Carry set (nothing
 487+ EA99              ; stored) if outside the guard band |X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z.
 488+ EA99              guard_proj:
 489+ EA99 DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 490+ EA9C DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 491+ EA9F E5                   push hl                         ; Z
 492+ EAA0 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
 493+ EAA3 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
 494+ EAA6 CD 41 AD             call abs_hl
 495+ EAA9 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |X|
 496+ EAAA E1                   pop hl
 497+ EAAB E5                   push hl
 498+ EAAC 29                   add hl,hl                       ; 2Z (carry: over 65535, so more)
 499+ EAAD 38 04                jr c,.g1
 500+ EAAF ED 52                sbc hl,de
 501+ EAB1 38 45                jr c,.out
 502+ EAB3 DD 6E 02     .g1:    ld l,(ix+2)
 503+ EAB6 DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
 504+ EAB9 CD 41 AD             call abs_hl
 505+ EABC EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |Y|
 506+ EABD E1                   pop hl
 507+ EABE E5                   push hl
 508+ EABF B7                   or a
 509+ EAC0 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 510+ EAC2 38 34                jr c,.out

 512+ EAC5 7D                   ld a,l                          ; (zpatch tests HL = 0 with A = L)
 513+ EAC6 CD 88 E9             call zpatch
 514+ EAC9 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
 515+ EACC DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
 516+ EACF 11 80 00             ld de,128
 517+ EAD2 01 01 FF             ld bc,255<<8|1                  ; x: 0..255, c2_or bits 0, 1
 518+ EAD5 CD FB EA             call c2_scr                     ; 128 + 128X/Z
 519+ EAD8 FD 75 00             ld (iy+0),l
 520+ EADB FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 521+ EADE DD 6E 02             ld l,(ix+2)
 522+ EAE1 DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
 523+ EAE4 CD 3A AD             call neg_hl
 524+ EAE7 11 40 00             ld de,VIEW_CY
 525+ EAEA 01 04 7F             ld bc,(VIEW_H-1)<<8|4           ; y: 0..VIEW_H-1, c2_or bits 2, 3
 526+ EAED CD FB EA             call c2_scr                     ; VIEW_CY - 128Y/Z
 527+ EAF0 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l
 528+ EAF3 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 529+ EAF6 B7                   or a
 530+ EAF7 C9                   ret
 531+ EAF8 E1           .out:   pop hl
 532+ EAF9 37                   scf
 533+ EAFA C9                   ret
 534+ EAFB
 535+ EAFB              ; HL = component, DE = the screen centre, B = the upper bound, C = the lower
 536+ EAFB              ; plane's c2_or bit (the upper's is the next) -> HL = DE + 128 HL / Z (the
 537+ EAFB              ; Z patched in by zpatch), and the plane it is outside, if any, into c2_or
 538+ EAFB              c2_scr:
 539+ EAFB C5                   push bc
 540+ EAFC D5                   push de
 541+ EAFD 7C                   ld a,h
 542+ EAFE F5                   push af
 543+ EAFF CD 20 EB             call scomp16
 544+ EB02 F1                   pop af
 545+ EB03 17                   rla
 546+ EB04 DC 3A AD             call c,neg_hl
 547+ EB07 D1                   pop de
 548+ EB08 19                   add hl,de
 549+ EB09 C1                   pop bc
 550+ EB0A 7C                   ld a,h
 551+ EB0B B7                   or a
 552+ EB0C 28 05                jr z,.z
 553+ EB0E FA 18 EB             jp m,.lo                        ; < 0
 554+ EB11 18 03                jr .hi                          ; > 255
 555+ EB13 78           .z:     ld a,b
 556+ EB14 BD                   cp l
 557+ EB15 D0                   ret nc                          ; inside
 558+ EB16 CB 21        .hi:    sla c
 559+ EB18 3A DB E0     .lo:    ld a,(c2_or)
 560+ EB1B B1                   or c
 561+ EB1C 32 DB E0             ld (c2_or),a
 562+ EB1F C9                   ret
 563+ EB20
 564+ EB20              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as
 565+ EB20              ; scale_comp (the same shift and reciprocal, patched into it by zpatch),
 566+ EB20              ; with a 10-bit Xn and a 16-bit result
 567+ EB20              scomp16:
 568+ EB20 CD 41 AD             call abs_hl
 569+ EB23 EB                   ex de,hl
 570+ EB24 3A F2 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.sh+1)          ; the shift zpatch set: its count,
 571+ EB27 47                   ld b,a
 572+ EB28 3A F4 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.op+1)          ; and which way (its opcode)
 573+ EB2B FE 28                cp OP_BSLA
 574+ EB2D 28 04                jr z,.l
 575+ EB2F ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 576+ EB31 18 02                jr .s
 577+ EB33 ED 28        .l:     bsla de,b
 578+ EB35 EB           .s:     ex de,hl
 579+ EB36 7C                   ld a,h
 580+ EB37 FE 04                cp 4
 581+ EB39 38 03                jr c,.ok
 582+ EB3B 21 FF 03             ld hl,1023                      ; (rounding at the guard band's edge)
 583+ EB3E 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bits 8-9 of Xn
 584+ EB3F 3A FE EB             ld a,(scale_comp.rl+1)
 585+ EB42 5F                   ld e,a
 586+ EB43 55                   ld d,l
 587+ EB44 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 588+ EB46 4A                   ld c,d
 589+ EB47 3A 04 EC             ld a,(scale_comp.rh+1)
 590+ EB4A 5F                   ld e,a
 591+ EB4B 55                   ld d,l
 592+ EB4C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 593+ EB4E 79                   ld a,c
 594+ EB4F 83                   add a,e
 595+ EB50 6F                   ld l,a
 596+ EB51 7A                   ld a,d
 597+ EB52 CE 00                adc a,0
 598+ EB54 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 599+ EB55 0E 00                ld c,0
 600+ EB57 78                   ld a,b
 601+ EB58 B7                   or a
 602+ EB59 28 0A                jr z,.nh
 603+ EB5B ED 5B 14 EC          ld de,(scale_comp.r16+1)
 604+ EB5F 19           .ad:    add hl,de                       ; + (256 * Xh * R) >> 8
 605+ EB60 30 01                jr nc,.a1
 606+ EB62 0C                   inc c
 607+ EB63 10 FA        .a1:    djnz .ad
 608+ EB65 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 609+ EB66 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 610+ EB68 0C                   inc c
 611+ EB69 6C           .nr:    ld l,h
 612+ EB6A 61                   ld h,c
 613+ EB6B CB 3C                srl h
 614+ EB6D CB 1D                rr l                            ; HL = (C:H) >> 1 = P >> 9
 615+ EB6F C9                   ret
 616+ EB70
 617+ EB70              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 618+ EB70              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 619+ EB70              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 620+ EB70              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 621+ EB70              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 622+ EB70              c2_isect:
 623+ EB70 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 624+ EB73 ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 625+ EB77 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 626+ EB7A 17                   rla
 627+ EB7B 30 01                jr nc,.sin
 628+ EB7D EB                   ex de,hl                        ; S outside: E is the inside end
 629+ EB7E 3A DC E0     .sin:   ld a,(c2_off)
 630+ EB81 EE 02                xor 2                           ; the other coordinate
 631+ EB83 ED 31                add hl,a
 632+ EB85 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 633+ EB86 23                   inc hl
 634+ EB87 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; o_in
 635+ EB88 EB                   ex de,hl
 636+ EB89 ED 31                add hl,a
 637+ EB8B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 638+ EB8C 23                   inc hl
 639+ EB8D 66                   ld h,(hl)
 640+ EB8E 6F                   ld l,a                          ; o_out
 641+ EB8F B7                   or a
 642+ EB90 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; o_out - o_in
 643+ EB92 28 26                jr z,.same                      ; (a vertical / horizontal edge: o_in)
 644+ EB94 C5                   push bc
 645+ EB95 E5                   push hl
 646+ EB96 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 647+ EB99 CD 41 AD             call abs_hl
 648+ EB9C EB                   ex de,hl
 649+ EB9D 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 650+ EBA0 CD 41 AD             call abs_hl
 651+ EBA3 19                   add hl,de
 652+ EBA4 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |dS| + |dE|

 654+ EBA8 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 655+ EBAA 28 03                jr z,.di
 656+ EBAC 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 657+ EBAF CD 83 E8     .di:    call div_frac                   ; t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|)
 658+ EBB2 E1                   pop hl                          ; o_out - o_in

 660+ EBB5 D1                   pop de
 661+ EBB6 CD 50 E8             call mul_frac
 662+ EBB9 C1                   pop bc
 663+ EBBA 09           .same:  add hl,bc                       ; o_in + t (o_out - o_in)
 664+ EBBB 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 665+ EBBE B7                   or a
 666+ EBBF 20 12                jr nz,.y
 667+ EBC1 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l                     ; an x plane: y worked out
 668+ EBC4 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 669+ EBC7 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 670+ EBCA FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 671+ EBCD FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 672+ EBD1 18 10                jr .f
 673+ EBD3 FD 75 00     .y:     ld (iy+0),l                     ; a y plane: x worked out
 674+ EBD6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 675+ EBD9 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 676+ EBDC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 677+ EBDF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 678+ EBE3 C3 50 EE     .f:     jp clip_isect.nz                ; its edge flag, IY and clip_on on
 679+ EBE6                  ENDIF
 680+ EBE6
 681+ EBE6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 682+ EBE6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by zpatch: the shift
 683+ EBE6              ; as a barrel shift whose count and direction (its opcode, BSRL or BSLA)
 684+ EBE6              ; are both patched, so it runs straight through (a right shift by 0 for a Z
 685+ EBE6              ; already 256..511 leaves it as it is).
 686+ EBE6              scale_comp:
 687+ EBE6 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 688+ EBE8 28 06                jr z,.ap
 689+ EBEA AF                   xor a
 690+ EBEB 95                   sub l
 691+ EBEC 6F                   ld l,a
 692+ EBED 9F                   sbc a,a
 693+ EBEE 94                   sub h
 694+ EBEF 67                   ld h,a
 695+ EBF0 EB           .ap:    ex de,hl
 696+ EBF1 06 00        .sh:    ld b,0                          ; (zpatch: the count)
 697+ EBF3 ED 2A        .op:    bsrl de,b                       ; (zpatch: bsrl, or bsla)
 698+ EBF5 EB                   ex de,hl
 699+ EBF6                      ASSERT {b scale_comp.op} == $ED && {b scale_comp.op+1} == OP_BSRL
 700+ EBF6 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 701+ EBF7 FE 02                cp 2
 702+ EBF9 30 27                jr nc,.big
 703+ EBFB 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bit 8 of Xn
 704+ EBFC 55                   ld d,l
 705+ EBFD 1E 00        .rl:    ld e,0
 706+ EBFF ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 707+ EC01 4A                   ld c,d
 708+ EC02 55                   ld d,l
 709+ EC03 1E 00        .rh:    ld e,0
 710+ EC05 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 711+ EC07 79                   ld a,c
 712+ EC08 83                   add a,e
 713+ EC09 6F                   ld l,a
 714+ EC0A 7A                   ld a,d
 715+ EC0B CE 00                adc a,0
 716+ EC0D 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 717+ EC0E 0E 00                ld c,0
 718+ EC10 05                   dec b
 719+ EC11 20 06                jr nz,.nh
 720+ EC13 11 00 00     .r16:   ld de,0
 721+ EC16 19                   add hl,de                       ; + (256*R) >> 8
 722+ EC17 CB 11                rl c
 723+ EC19 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 724+ EC1A 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 725+ EC1C 0C                   inc c
 726+ EC1D 79           .nr:    ld a,c
 727+ EC1E 1F                   rra
 728+ EC1F 7C                   ld a,h
 729+ EC20 1F                   rra                             ; A = (C:H) >> 1  = P >> 9
 730+ EC21 C9                   ret
 731+ EC22 21 FF 01     .big:   ld hl,511                       ; clamp (rounding at frustum edge)
 732+ EC25 18 D4                jr .ok
 733+ EC27
 734+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 735+ EC27              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 736+ EC27              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 737+ EC27              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 738+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 739+ EC27              calc_oc:
 740+ EC27 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 741+ EC28 23                   inc hl
 742+ EC29 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE = X
 743+ EC2A 23                   inc hl
 744+ EC2B 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 745+ EC2C 23                   inc hl
 746+ EC2D 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; BC = Y
 747+ EC2E 23                   inc hl
 748+ EC2F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 749+ EC30 23                   inc hl
 750+ EC31 66                   ld h,(hl)
 751+ EC32 6F                   ld l,a                          ; HL = Z
 752+ EC33 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 753+ EC35 20 0D                jr nz,.nr
 754+ EC37 7C                   ld a,h
 755+ EC38 B7                   or a
 756+ EC39 3E 00                ld a,0
 757+ EC3B 20 09                jr nz,.n1
 758+ EC3D 7D                   ld a,l
 759+ EC3E FE 10                cp NEAR
 760+ EC40 3E 00                ld a,0
 761+ EC42 30 02                jr nc,.n1
 762+ EC44 3E 01        .nr:    ld a,1
 763+ EC46 E5           .n1:    push hl
 764+ EC47 19                   add hl,de                       ; Z+X
 765+ EC48 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 766+ EC4A 28 02                jr z,.n2

 853+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 854+ ECCA              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 855+ ECCA              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 856+ ECCA              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 857+ ECCA              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 858+ ECCA              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 859+ ECCA              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 860+ ECCA              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.

1277+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1278+ F049              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1279+ F049              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1280+ F049              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row
1281+ F049              ;   then has one entry in each, and the span between them is filled.
1282+ F049              ;   Winding doesn't matter.
1283+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1284+ F049              fill_poly:
1285+ F049 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1286+ F04C 47                   ld b,a
1287+ F04D 21 81 E0             ld hl,p2buf+1
1288+ F050 0E FF                ld c,255
1289+ F052 16 00                ld d,0
1290+ F054 7E           .mm:    ld a,(hl)
1291+ F055 B9                   cp c
1292+ F056 30 01                jr nc,.m1
1293+ F058 4F                   ld c,a
1294+ F059 BA           .m1:    cp d
1295+ F05A 38 01                jr c,.m2
1296+ F05C 57                   ld d,a
1297+ F05D 23           .m2:    inc hl
1298+ F05E 23                   inc hl
1299+ F05F 23                   inc hl
1300+ F060 23                   inc hl
1301+ F061 10 F1                djnz .mm
1302+ F063 79                   ld a,c
1303+ F064 BA                   cp d
1304+ F065 C8                   ret z                           ; zero height - outline only
1305+ F066 32 E9 E0             ld (fy0),a

1307+ F06C BE                   cp (hl)                         ; nearer buildings, drawn after this
1308+ F06D D0                   ret nc                          ; one (occlusion): none to fill

1310+ F06F 3D                   dec a
1311+ F070 BA                   cp d
1312+ F071 38 01                jr c,.cut                       ; the last row to fill: the lower of
1313+ F073 7A                   ld a,d                          ; the face's and bld_cut-1
1314+ F074 32 EA E0     .cut:   ld (fy1),a
1315+ F077
1316+ F077 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1317+ F07B 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1318+ F07E 32 EB E0             ld (fe_cnt),a
1319+ F081 DD 56 00     .ed:    ld d,(ix+0)
1320+ F084 DD 5E 01             ld e,(ix+1)
1321+ F087 DD 46 04             ld b,(ix+4)
1322+ F08A DD 4E 05             ld c,(ix+5)
1323+ F08D 7B                   ld a,e
1324+ F08E B9                   cp c
1325+ F08F 28 15                jr z,.nx                        ; horizontal edge
1326+ F091 38 0A                jr c,.down

1328+ F094 50                   ld d,b

1333+ F099 3E E3                ld a,high TB

1336+ F09F DD E5        .walk:  push ix
1337+ F0A1 CD CB F0             call walk_edge
1338+ F0A4 DD E1                pop ix
1339+ F0A6 01 04 00     .nx:    ld bc,4
1340+ F0A9 DD 09                add ix,bc
1341+ F0AB 21 EB E0             ld hl,fe_cnt
1342+ F0AE 35                   dec (hl)
1343+ F0AF 20 D0                jr nz,.ed
1344+ F0B1

1346+ F0B4 32 72 A3             ld (l2_cls_byte),a              ; DMA source byte for long spans
1347+ F0B7                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
1348+ F0B7 4F                   ld c,a                          ; DMA+: the fill value (the spans'
1349+ F0B8 3E F7                ld a,DDMA_FILL_VALUE            ; fill mode, and the rectangles')
1350+ F0BA D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1351+ F0BC 79                   ld a,c
1352+ F0BD D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1353+ F0BF 57                   ld d,a
1354+ F0C0 5F                   ld e,a                          ; PUSH pair for short spans
1355+ F0C1                    IFDEF NO_BLOCKS
1356+ F0C1 ~                    jp fill_spans                   ; (-DNO_BLOCKS: spans only, to compare)
1357+ F0C1                    ELSE
1358+ F0C1 3A 8A AD             ld a,(pitch)                    ; level flight: runs of equal rows as
1359+ F0C4 B7                   or a                            ; rectangles (the walls' edges are
1360+ F0C5 CA 8E F3             jp z,fill_blocks                ; upright on the screen); pitched they
1361+ F0C8 C3 59 F1             jp fill_spans                   ; lean, and rows rarely repeat
1362+ F0CB                    ENDIF
1363+ F0CB                  ELSE
1364+ F0CB ~                    ld d,a
1365+ F0CB ~                    ld e,a                          ; PUSH pair for short spans
1366+ F0CB ~                    jp fill_spans
1367+ F0CB                  ENDIF
1368+ F0CB
1369+ F0CB              ; Walk an edge (D=xa, E=ya) -> (B=xb, C=yb), yb > ya, into table page A.
1370+ F0CB              ; Bresenham style: x += q each row, fractional r/dy accumulated in a biased
1371+ F0CB              ; byte (carry == wrap), so the end point is hit exactly.
1372+ F0CB              walk_edge:
1373+ F0CB 67                   ld h,a
1374+ F0CC 6B                   ld l,e
1375+ F0CD 79                   ld a,c
1376+ F0CE 93                   sub e
1377+ F0CF 4F                   ld c,a                          ; C = dy (1..191)
1378+ F0D0 78                   ld a,b
1379+ F0D1 92                   sub d                           ; dx
1380+ F0D2 28 72                jr z,.vert                      ; vertical (every wall in level flight)
1381+ F0D4 38 37                jr c,.neg
1382+ F0D6 B9                   cp c
1383+ F0D7 30 07                jr nc,.pdv
1384+ F0D9 DD 6F                ld ixl,a                        ; steep: q = 0, r = dx
1385+ F0DB CD 4D F1             call .setup
1386+ F0DE 18 20                jr .p0s
1387+ F0E0 CD 0B E9     .pdv:   call div8                       ; E = q, A = r
1388+ F0E3 DD 63                ld ixh,e
1389+ F0E5 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1390+ F0E7 CD 4D F1             call .setup

1392+ F0EC B7                   or a
1393+ F0ED 28 11                jr z,.p0s
1394+ F0EF 72           .pl:    ld (hl),d
1395+ F0F0 2C                   inc l
1396+ F0F1 7A                   ld a,d
1397+ F0F2 DD 84                add a,ixh
1398+ F0F4 57                   ld d,a
1399+ F0F5 7B                   ld a,e
1400+ F0F6 DD 85                add a,ixl
1401+ F0F8 30 02                jr nc,.pl1
1402+ F0FA 81                   add a,c
1403+ F0FB 14                   inc d
1404+ F0FC 5F           .pl1:   ld e,a
1405+ F0FD 10 F0                djnz .pl
1406+ F0FF C9                   ret
1407+ F100              ; (no x step: the accumulator kept in A and the remainder in E, not IXL)
1408+ F100 7B           .p0s:   ld a,e
1409+ F101 DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1410+ F103 72           .p0:    ld (hl),d
1411+ F104 2C                   inc l
1412+ F105 83                   add a,e
1413+ F106 30 02                jr nc,.p01
1414+ F108 81                   add a,c
1415+ F109 14                   inc d
1416+ F10A 10 F7        .p01:   djnz .p0
1417+ F10C C9                   ret
1418+ F10D
1419+ F10D ED 44        .neg:   neg
1420+ F10F B9                   cp c
1421+ F110 30 07                jr nc,.ndv
1422+ F112 DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1423+ F114 CD 4D F1             call .setup
1424+ F117 18 20                jr .n0s
1425+ F119 CD 0B E9     .ndv:   call div8
1426+ F11C DD 63                ld ixh,e
1427+ F11E DD 6F                ld ixl,a
1428+ F120 CD 4D F1             call .setup
1429+ F123 DD 7C                ld a,ixh
1430+ F125 B7                   or a
1431+ F126 28 11                jr z,.n0s
1432+ F128 72           .nl:    ld (hl),d
1433+ F129 2C                   inc l
1434+ F12A 7A                   ld a,d
1435+ F12B DD 94                sub ixh
1436+ F12D 57                   ld d,a
1437+ F12E 7B                   ld a,e
1438+ F12F DD 85                add a,ixl
1439+ F131 30 02                jr nc,.nl1
1440+ F133 81                   add a,c
1441+ F134 15                   dec d
1442+ F135 5F           .nl1:   ld e,a
1443+ F136 10 F0                djnz .nl
1444+ F138 C9                   ret
1445+ F139 7B           .n0s:   ld a,e
1446+ F13A DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1447+ F13C 72           .n0:    ld (hl),d
1448+ F13D 2C                   inc l
1449+ F13E 83                   add a,e
1450+ F13F 30 02                jr nc,.n01
1451+ F141 81                   add a,c
1452+ F142 15                   dec d
1453+ F143 10 F7        .n01:   djnz .n0
1454+ F145 C9                   ret
1455+ F146
1456+ F146              ; A vertical edge: the same x on every row (as the steep walk gives it with
1457+ F146              ; no x step: exactly)
1458+ F146 41           .vert:  ld b,c
1459+ F147 04                   inc b                           ; dy+1 rows
1460+ F148 72           .vl:    ld (hl),d
1461+ F149 2C                   inc l
1462+ F14A 10 FC                djnz .vl
1463+ F14C C9                   ret
1464+ F14D
1465+ F14D              ; B = dy+1 rows, E = biased accumulator (dy/2 - dy), C = -dy
1466+ F14D 41           .setup: ld b,c
1467+ F14E 04                   inc b
1468+ F14F 79                   ld a,c
1469+ F150 CB 3F                srl a
1470+ F152 91                   sub c
1471+ F153 5F                   ld e,a
1472+ F154 79                   ld a,c
1473+ F155 ED 44                neg
1474+ F157 4F                   ld c,a
1475+ F158 C9                   ret
1476+ F159
1477+ F159              ;==============================================================================
1478+ F159              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1479+ F159              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1480+ F159              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1481+ F159              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1482+ F159              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1483+ F159              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1484+ F159              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1485+ F159              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1486+ F159              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1487+ F159              ;==============================================================================
1488+ F159              fill_spans:
1489+ F159 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1490+ F15C CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1491+ F15F FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0
1492+ F163 FD 39                add iy,sp                       ; the stack, for push_end
1493+ F165 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1494+ F168 47                   ld b,a
1495+ F169 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)
1496+ F16C 90                   sub b
1497+ F16D 3C                   inc a
1498+ F16E DD 67                ld ixh,a                        ; rows to fill
1499+ F170 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)                      ; the middle row: which table is left?
1500+ F173 80                   add a,b
1501+ F174 1F                   rra
1502+ F175 6F                   ld l,a
1503+ F176 26 E2                ld h,high TA
1504+ F178 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1505+ F179 24                   inc h
1506+ F17A BE                   cp (hl)
1507+ F17B 3E E2                ld a,high TA                    ; TA left (or level): TA first
1508+ F17D 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)
1509+ F17F 38 04                jr c,.ta
1510+ F181 3E E3                ld a,high TB                    ; TB left: TB first
1511+ F183 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1512+ F185 32 8D F1     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1513+ F188 79                   ld a,c
1514+ F189 32 90 F1             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1515+ F18C
1516+ F18C              fs_loop:
1517+ F18C 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1518+ F18E 68                   ld l,b
1519+ F18F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1520+ F190 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1521+ F191 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1522+ F192 B9                   cp c
1523+ F193 38 03                jr c,.ord
1524+ F195 69                   ld l,c
1525+ F196 4F                   ld c,a
1526+ F197 7D                   ld a,l
1527+ F198 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1528+ F199 78                   ld a,b
1529+ F19A E6 1F                and 31
1530+ F19C 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1531+ F19D 79                   ld a,c
1532+ F19E 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1533+ F19F FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1534+ F1A1 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1535+ F1A3 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1536+ F1A5 38 07                jr c,.even
1537+ F1A7 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1538+ F1A8 B7                   or a
1539+ F1A9 CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1540+ F1AC 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1541+ F1AE 3C           .even:  inc a
1542+ F1AF 69           .go:    ld l,c
1543+ F1B0 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1544+ F1B1 F9                   ld sp,hl
1545+ F1B2 6F                   ld l,a
1546+ F1B3 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1547+ F1B5 95                   sub l
1548+ F1B6 6F                   ld l,a
1549+ F1B7 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1550+ F1B9 E9                   jp (hl)
1551+ F1BA                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1552+ F1BA
1553+ F1BA                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1554+ F1BA                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1555+ F1BA 3C           .dma:   inc a
1556+ F1BB 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1557+ F1BD 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1558+ F1BE 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1559+ F1C0              .dmal:
1560+ F1C0 4F                   ld c,a
1561+ F1C1 3E 25                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_LO
1562+ F1C3 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1563+ F1C5 79                   ld a,c
1564+ F1C6 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; length = width
1565+ F1C8 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1566+ F1CA D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1567+ F1CC 7D                   ld a,l
1568+ F1CD D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; port B = y*256 + x
1569+ F1CF 7C                   ld a,h
1570+ F1D0 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1571+ F1D2 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1572+ F1D4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1573+ F1D6 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1574+ F1D8 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; CPU waits until the span is written
1575+ F1DA 04                   inc b                           ; the next row (as push_next: SP was
1576+ F1DB DD 25                dec ixh                         ; never borrowed here)
1577+ F1DD C8                   ret z
1578+ F1DE 78                   ld a,b
1579+ F1DF E6 1F                and 31
1580+ F1E1 C2 8C F1             jp nz,fs_loop
1581+ F1E4 C3 8E E1             jp push_next.sect
1582+ F1E7                      ASSERT high TB == high TA + 1
1583+ F1E7
1584+ F1E7              ;==============================================================================
1585+ F1E7              ; Outline the polygon in p2buf, skipping edges flagged 0 (clip edges)
1586+ F1E7              ;==============================================================================
1587+ F1E7              outline_poly:
1588+ F1E7 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1589+ F1EB 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1590+ F1EE 47                   ld b,a
1591+ F1EF C5           .lp:    push bc
1592+ F1F0 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
1593+ F1F3 B7                   or a
1594+ F1F4 28 0F                jr z,.sk
1595+ F1F6 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1596+ F1F9 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1597+ F1FC DD 5E 04             ld e,(ix+4)
1598+ F1FF DD 56 05             ld d,(ix+5)
1599+ F202 CD 0E F2             call draw_line
1600+ F205 01 04 00     .sk:    ld bc,4
1601+ F208 DD 09                add ix,bc
1602+ F20A C1                   pop bc
1603+ F20B 10 E2                djnz .lp
1604+ F20D C9                   ret
1605+ F20E
1606+ F20E              ;==============================================================================
1607+ F20E              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1608+ F20E              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1609+ F20E              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.
1610+ F20E              ;==============================================================================
1611+ F20E              draw_line:
1612+ F20E 3A EC E0             ld a,(line_col)
1613+ F211 4F                   ld c,a
1614+ F212 7B                   ld a,e
1615+ F213 95                   sub l
1616+ F214 30 06                jr nc,.xp
1617+ F216 ED 44                neg
1618+ F218 06 2D                ld b,OP_DEC_L
1619+ F21A 18 02                jr .xd
1620+ F21C 06 2C        .xp:    ld b,OP_INC_L
1621+ F21E 5F           .xd:    ld e,a                          ; |dx|
1622+ F21F 78                   ld a,b
1623+ F220 32 48 F2             ld (.smx1),a
1624+ F223 32 65 F2             ld (.smx2),a
1625+ F226 7A                   ld a,d
1626+ F227 94                   sub h
1627+ F228 30 06                jr nc,.yp
1628+ F22A ED 44                neg
1629+ F22C 06 25                ld b,OP_DEC_H
1630+ F22E 18 02                jr .yd
1631+ F230 06 24        .yp:    ld b,OP_INC_H
1632+ F232 57           .yd:    ld d,a                          ; |dy|
1633+ F233 78                   ld a,b
1634+ F234 32 4C F2             ld (.smy1),a
1635+ F237 32 5C F2             ld (.smy2),a
1636+ F23A 7C                   ld a,h
1637+ F23B CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; page in the start row's section
1638+ F23E 67                   ld h,a                          ; y within the section
1639+ F23F 7B                   ld a,e
1640+ F240 BA                   cp d
1641+ F241 38 13                jr c,.ymaj
1642+ F243 43                   ld b,e
1643+ F244 04                   inc b
1644+ F245 CB 3F                srl a
1645+ F247 71           .xl:    ld (hl),c
1646+ F248 2C           .smx1:  inc l
1647+ F249 92                   sub d
1648+ F24A 30 07                jr nc,.xs
1649+ F24C 24           .smy1:  inc h
1650+ F24D CB 6C                bit 5,h                         ; left the 32-row section?
1651+ F24F C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1652+ F252 83                   add a,e
1653+ F253 10 F2        .xs:    djnz .xl
1654+ F255 C9                   ret
1655+ F256 42           .ymaj:  ld b,d
1656+ F257 04                   inc b
1657+ F258 7A                   ld a,d
1658+ F259 CB 3F                srl a
1659+ F25B 71           .yl:    ld (hl),c
1660+ F25C 24           .smy2:  inc h
1661+ F25D CB 6C                bit 5,h
1662+ F25F C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1663+ F262 93                   sub e
1664+ F263 30 02                jr nc,.ys
1665+ F265 2C           .smx2:  inc l
1666+ F266 82                   add a,d
1667+ F267 10 F2        .ys:    djnz .yl
1668+ F269 C9                   ret
1669+ F26A
1670+ F26A              ;==============================================================================
1671+ F26A              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1672+ F26A              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon
1673+ F26A              ; row, ground below.  The fills are dma_fill's (layer2_cls.asm, resident),
1674+ F26A              ; the l2_fill command block with its destination (port B) and length; the source
1675+ F26A              ; (port A) is the fixed byte l2_cls_byte.  Zero-length fills are skipped.
1676+ F26A              ;==============================================================================
1677+ F26A              clear_screen:
1678+ F26A                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
1679+ F26A                      ; DMA+: the sky and the ground as two filled rectangles in the
1680+ F26A                      ; buffer at seg_base (dd_rect): no paging, one set-up each
1681+ F26A CD E4 F2             call span_arm                   ; (the DMA as the spans want it after)
1682+ F26D 3A 8B B4             ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows = clamp(hz, 0, VIEW_H)
1683+ F270                    IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1684+ F270 3C                   inc a                           ; (and the horizon row: see below)
1685+ F271                    ENDIF
1686+ F271 FE 81                cp VIEW_H+1
1687+ F273 38 02                jr c,.hs
1688+ F275 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H
1689+ F277 32 EE E0     .hs:    ld (cs_sky),a
1690+ F27A B7                   or a
1691+ F27B 28 08                jr z,.hg
1692+ F27D 47                   ld b,a                          ; sky: (0, 0), 256 x sky rows
1693+ F27E 16 00                ld d,0
1694+ F280                    IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1695+ F280 3E 01                ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE
1696+ F282                    ELSE
1697+ F282 ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1698+ F282                    ENDIF
1699+ F282 CD 60 F3             call dd_band
1700+ F285 3A EE E0     .hg:    ld a,(cs_sky)                   ; ground: under it, to VIEW_H
1701+ F288 FE 80                cp VIEW_H
1702+ F28A 28 0B                jr z,.hd
1703+ F28C 57                   ld d,a
1704+ F28D ED 44                neg
1705+ F28F C6 80                add a,VIEW_H
1706+ F291 47                   ld b,a
1707+ F292 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL
1708+ F294 CD 60 F3             call dd_band
1709+ F297 C3 85 F3     .hd:    jp dd_spans                     ; (the rectangles' flags off again)
1710+ F29A                  ENDIF
1711+ F29A 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; C = first row of the section
1712+ F29C 79           .sec:   ld a,c
1713+ F29D CD 20 E8             call seg_map
1714+ F2A0 3A 8B B4             ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows here = clamp(hz - C, 0, 32)
1715+ F2A3                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1716+ F2A3 3C                   inc a                           ; the horizon row too: at the horizon
1717+ F2A4                                                      ; it is all distant wall, and it hides
1718+ F2A4                                                      ; a 1-row rounding gap under the
1719+ F2A4                                                      ; wall's top edge when pitched
1720+ F2A4                  ENDIF
1721+ F2A4 91                   sub c
1722+ F2A5 30 01                jr nc,.s1
1723+ F2A7 AF                   xor a
1724+ F2A8 FE 21        .s1:    cp 33
1725+ F2AA 38 02                jr c,.s2
1726+ F2AC 3E 20                ld a,32
1727+ F2AE 32 EE E0     .s2:    ld (cs_sky),a
1728+ F2B1 B7                   or a
1729+ F2B2 28 0D                jr z,.gnd
1730+ F2B4 C5                   push bc
1731+ F2B5 47                   ld b,a                          ; sky: section start, rows*256 bytes
1732+ F2B6 0E 00                ld c,0
1733+ F2B8 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1734+ F2BB                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1735+ F2BB 3E 01                ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE   ; "sky" is the perimeter wall
1736+ F2BD                  ELSE
1737+ F2BD ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1738+ F2BD                  ENDIF
1739+ F2BD CD 8B A3             call dma_fill
1740+ F2C0 C1                   pop bc
1741+ F2C1 3A EE E0     .gnd:   ld a,(cs_sky)
1742+ F2C4 FE 20                cp 32
1743+ F2C6 28 11                jr z,.nx
1744+ F2C8 C5                   push bc
1745+ F2C9 67                   ld h,a                          ; ground: after the sky rows
1746+ F2CA 2E 00                ld l,0
1747+ F2CC ED 44                neg
1748+ F2CE C6 20                add a,32
1749+ F2D0 47                   ld b,a
1750+ F2D1 0E 00                ld c,0
1751+ F2D3 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL
1752+ F2D5 CD 8B A3             call dma_fill
1753+ F2D8 C1                   pop bc
1754+ F2D9 79           .nx:    ld a,c
1755+ F2DA C6 20                add a,32
1756+ F2DC 4F                   ld c,a
1757+ F2DD FE 80                cp VIEW_H
1758+ F2DF 20 BB                jr nz,.sec
1759+ F2E1                      ; Leave the DMA ready for fill_spans: length high byte 0, so each span
1760+ F2E1                      ; only reloads length low, destination, LOAD and ENABLE.  fill_poly
1761+ F2E1                      ; puts each building's colour in the source byte l2_cls_byte.
1762+ F2E1              .spans:
1763+ F2E1                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
1764+ F2E1 C3 E4 F2             jp span_arm
1765+ F2E4                  ELSE
1766+ F2E4 ~                    ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_HI
1767+ F2E4 ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1768+ F2E4 ~                    xor a
1769+ F2E4 ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1770+ F2E4 ~                    ret
1771+ F2E4                  ENDIF
1772+ F2E4
1773+ F2E4                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
1774+ F2E4              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1775+ F2E4              ; DMA+ (real hardware: docs/ZXNDDMA.md)
1776+ F2E4              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1777+ F2E4              ; The DMA set up for the spans: reset, port A the fixed byte l2_cls_byte (not
1778+ F2E4              ; read: fill mode), length 0 (each span reloads its low byte), port B
1779+ F2E4              ; counting up, continuous, stop at the end; fill mode on (fill_poly sends
1780+ F2E4              ; each face's colour as the fill value).  Then fill_spans' short reload
1781+ F2E4              ; (length low, destination, load, enable) is all a span needs.
1782+ F2E4              span_arm:
1783+ F2E4 21 ED F2             ld hl,sa_cmds
1784+ F2E7 01 6B 0F             ld bc,SA_N<<8 | IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT
1785+ F2EA ED B3                otir
1786+ F2EC C9                   ret
1787+ F2ED 83 C3        sa_cmds:    db DMA_DISABLE, DMA_RESET
1788+ F2EF 7D                       db DMA_WRO_BLOCK_PORTA_A2B_XFR
1789+ F2F0 72 A3 00 00              dw l2_cls_byte, 0
1790+ F2F4 24 10                    db DMA_WR1_P1FIXED_MEMORY, DMA_WR2_P2INC_MEMORY
1791+ F2F6 AD                       db DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1792+ F2F7 00 00                    dw 0
1793+ F2F9 82                       db DMA_STOP_AT_END
1794+ F2FA DF 08                    db DDMA_MODE, DDMA_FLAG_FILL
1795+ F2FC              SA_N        equ $ - sa_cmds
1796+ F2FC
1797+ F2FC              ; A filled rectangle in the Layer 2 buffer being drawn (seg_base: its first
1798+ F2FC              ; 8K page; 256x192, a row 256 bytes on), by its physical address, so with no
1799+ F2FC              ; paging: E = x, D = y, C = width (0 = 256), B = height (1 or more), A =
1800+ F2FC              ; colour.  Port B: $40000 + seg_base * $2000 + y * 256 + x, stride 256, 2D,
1801+ F2FC              ; fill.  (Not the X,Y form on the hidden screen: the level's start clears
1802+ F2FC              ; both buffers before NextReg $13 is set.)  Over the spans' set-up
1803+ F2FC              ; (span_arm); leaves the rectangle's flags on: dd_spans puts the spans'
1804+ F2FC              ; back.
1805+ F2FC              dd_rect:
1806+ F2FC F5                   push af
1807+ F2FD 3E E3                ld a,DDMA_ROW_LEN               ; row length: the width
1808+ F2FF D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1809+ F301 79                   ld a,c
1810+ F302 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1811+ F304 B7                   or a
1812+ F305 3E 00                ld a,0
1813+ F307 20 01                jr nz,.w
1814+ F309 3C                   inc a                           ; (0: 256)
1815+ F30A D3 6B        .w:     out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1816+ F30C 3E E7                ld a,DDMA_ROWS                  ; rows: the height
1817+ F30E D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1818+ F310 78                   ld a,b
1819+ F311 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1820+ F313 AF                   xor a
1821+ F314 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1822+ F316 3E F7                ld a,DDMA_FILL_VALUE            ; the colour
1823+ F318 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1824+ F31A F1                   pop af
1825+ F31B D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1826+ F31D 3A B2 B4             ld a,(seg_base)                 ; the address: bits 23:16 = 4 +
1827+ F320 6F                   ld l,a                          ; seg_base / 8,
1828+ F321 0F                   rrca
1829+ F322 0F                   rrca
1830+ F323 0F                   rrca
1831+ F324 E6 1F                and 31
1832+ F326 C6 04                add a,4
1833+ F328 67                   ld h,a
1834+ F329 7D                   ld a,l                          ; 15:8 = (seg_base & 7) * 32 + y
1835+ F32A E6 07                and 7
1836+ F32C 0F                   rrca
1837+ F32D 0F                   rrca
1838+ F32E 0F                   rrca
1839+ F32F 82                   add a,d
1840+ F330 30 01                jr nc,.nc
1841+ F332 24                   inc h
1842+ F333 6F           .nc:    ld l,a
1843+ F334 3E DB                ld a,DDMA_B_EXT
1844+ F336 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1845+ F338 7C                   ld a,h
1846+ F339 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1847+ F33B 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE          ; 7:0 = x
1848+ F33D D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1849+ F33F 7B                   ld a,e
1850+ F340 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1851+ F342 7D                   ld a,l
1852+ F343 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1853+ F345 3E EF                ld a,DDMA_B_STRIDE              ; a row on: 256
1854+ F347 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1855+ F349 AF                   xor a
1856+ F34A D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1857+ F34C 3C                   inc a
1858+ F34D D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1859+ F34F 3E DF                ld a,DDMA_MODE                  ; physical, 2D, fill
1860+ F351 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1861+ F353 3E 0B                ld a,DDMA_RECT
1862+ F355 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1863+ F357 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1864+ F359 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1865+ F35B 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1866+ F35D D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; (the CPU waits while it fills)
1867+ F35F C9                   ret
1868+ F360
1869+ F360              ; Full-width rows D .. D+B-1 (B 1 or more) filled with A, as rectangles of at
1870+ F360              ; most DD_MAX_ROWS rows: each DMA burst holds the bus (and the 50 Hz
1871+ F360              ; interrupt, the sound) no longer than the old clear's 8K sections did
1872+ F360              DD_MAX_ROWS     equ 32
1873+ F360              dd_band:
1874+ F360 32 84 F3             ld (db_col),a
1875+ F363 78           .lp:    ld a,b
1876+ F364 FE 21                cp DD_MAX_ROWS+1
1877+ F366 38 02                jr c,.n
1878+ F368 3E 20                ld a,DD_MAX_ROWS
1879+ F36A 4F           .n:     ld c,a                          ; this piece's rows
1880+ F36B 78                   ld a,b
1881+ F36C 91                   sub c
1882+ F36D F5                   push af                         ; (the rest)
1883+ F36E 41                   ld b,c
1884+ F36F D5                   push de
1885+ F370 1E 00                ld e,0
1886+ F372 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; (256 wide)
1887+ F374 3A 84 F3             ld a,(db_col)
1888+ F377 CD FC F2             call dd_rect
1889+ F37A D1                   pop de
1890+ F37B F1                   pop af
1891+ F37C C8                   ret z
1892+ F37D 47                   ld b,a
1893+ F37E 7A                   ld a,d
1894+ F37F C6 20                add a,DD_MAX_ROWS
1895+ F381 57                   ld d,a
1896+ F382 18 DF                jr .lp
1897+ F384 00           db_col:     db 0                        ; dd_band: the colour
1898+ F385
1899+ F385              ; The spans' flags back after rectangles: fill mode, MMU addresses, no 2D
1900+ F385              dd_spans:
1901+ F385 3E DF                ld a,DDMA_MODE
1902+ F387 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1903+ F389 3E 08                ld a,DDMA_FLAG_FILL
1904+ F38B D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1905+ F38D C9                   ret
1906+ F38E
1907+ F38E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1908+ F38E              ; Block fill (in place of fill_spans): the face's rows fy0..fy1 (its edges in
1909+ F38E              ; TA / TB, after the edge walk), DE = its colour pair, the DMA's fill value
1910+ F38E              ; its colour (fill_poly).  Rows are taken in runs: a run goes on while each
1911+ F38E              ; row's left and right x are the last row's.  A run of BLOCK_ROWS rows or
1912+ F38E              ; more, BLOCK_W pixels wide or more, is one DMA+ rectangle (dd_rect: no
1913+ F38E              ; paging, one set-up); the rows between such runs go to fill_spans as they
1914+ F38E              ; are.  The same pixels as fill_spans alone: the render tests hold.
1915+ F38E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1916+ F38E                  IFDEF BLOCK_ROWS_SET            ; (-DBLOCK_ROWS_SET=n, -DBLOCK_W_SET=n:
1917+ F38E ~            BLOCK_ROWS      equ BLOCK_ROWS_SET  ;   to try others)
1918+ F38E                  ELSE
1919+ F38E              BLOCK_ROWS      equ 4               ; a rectangle: at least this many rows,
1920+ F38E                  ENDIF
1921+ F38E                  IFDEF BLOCK_W_SET
1922+ F38E ~            BLOCK_W         equ BLOCK_W_SET
1923+ F38E                  ELSE
1924+ F38E              BLOCK_W         equ 8               ;   this many pixels wide
1925+ F38E                  ENDIF
1926+ F38E              fill_blocks:
1927+ F38E ED 53 58 F4          ld (fb_de),de
1928+ F392 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)
1929+ F395 32 5B F4             ld (fb_end),a
1930+ F398 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1931+ F39B 32 5A F4             ld (fb_s),a                     ; the first row not drawn yet
1932+ F39E 4F                   ld c,a                          ; C = the run's first row
1933+ F39F AF                   xor a
1934+ F3A0 32 62 F4             ld (fb_rect),a                  ; (no rectangle yet: no flags to undo)
1935+ F3A3 69           .run:   ld l,c                          ; its edges: D = TA, E = TB
1936+ F3A4 26 E2                ld h,high TA
1937+ F3A6 56                   ld d,(hl)
1938+ F3A7 24                   inc h
1939+ F3A8 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1940+ F3A9 25                   dec h
1941+ F3AA 3A 5B F4             ld a,(fb_end)                   ; B = the rows after it to look at
1942+ F3AD 91                   sub c
1943+ F3AE 28 14                jr z,.last
1944+ F3B0 FE 20                cp DD_MAX_ROWS                  ; (a run of DD_MAX_ROWS at most: a
1945+ F3B2 38 02                jr c,.b                         ; DMA burst no longer than 8K)
1946+ F3B4 3E 1F                ld a,DD_MAX_ROWS-1
1947+ F3B6 47           .b:     ld b,a
1948+ F3B7 2C           .ext:   inc l                           ; on while both edges are the same
1949+ F3B8 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1950+ F3B9 BA                   cp d
1951+ F3BA 20 09                jr nz,.brk
1952+ F3BC 24                   inc h
1953+ F3BD 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1954+ F3BE 25                   dec h
1955+ F3BF BB                   cp e
1956+ F3C0 20 03                jr nz,.brk
1957+ F3C2 10 F3                djnz .ext
1958+ F3C4 2C           .last:  inc l                           ; (to the last row: L one past it)
1959+ F3C5 7D           .brk:   ld a,l                          ; the run: rows C .. L-1
1960+ F3C6 32 5C F4             ld (fb_next),a
1961+ F3C9 91                   sub c
1962+ F3CA FE 04                cp BLOCK_ROWS
1963+ F3CC 38 43                jr c,.next                      ; too few: spans
1964+ F3CE 47                   ld b,a                          ; B = rows
1965+ F3CF 7A                   ld a,d                          ; width - 1 = |TA - TB|: left = min
1966+ F3D0 93                   sub e
1967+ F3D1 30 03                jr nc,.w
1968+ F3D3 ED 44                neg
1969+ F3D5 5A                   ld e,d                          ; (TA left)
1970+ F3D6 FE 07        .w:     cp BLOCK_W-1
1971+ F3D8 38 37                jr c,.next                      ; too narrow: spans
1972+ F3DA 3C                   inc a                           ; width (256: 0)
1973+ F3DB 32 5F F4             ld (fb_w),a
1974+ F3DE 7B                   ld a,e
1975+ F3DF 32 5E F4             ld (fb_x),a
1976+ F3E2 78                   ld a,b
1977+ F3E3 32 60 F4             ld (fb_rows),a
1978+ F3E6 79                   ld a,c                          ; the rows before it, as spans
1979+ F3E7 32 5D F4             ld (fb_y0),a
1980+ F3EA 32 61 F4             ld (fb_upto),a
1981+ F3ED CD 2E F4             call fb_spans
1982+ F3F0 3A 5E F4             ld a,(fb_x)                     ; the run: one rectangle
1983+ F3F3 5F                   ld e,a
1984+ F3F4 3A 5D F4             ld a,(fb_y0)
1985+ F3F7 57                   ld d,a
1986+ F3F8 3A 5F F4             ld a,(fb_w)
1987+ F3FB 4F                   ld c,a
1988+ F3FC 3A 60 F4             ld a,(fb_rows)
1989+ F3FF 47                   ld b,a
1990+ F400 3A 58 F4             ld a,(fb_de)
1991+ F403 CD FC F2             call dd_rect
1992+ F406 3E 01                ld a,1
1993+ F408 32 62 F4             ld (fb_rect),a
1994+ F40B 3A 5C F4             ld a,(fb_next)                  ; drawn to here
1995+ F40E 32 5A F4             ld (fb_s),a
1996+ F411 3A 5C F4     .next:  ld a,(fb_next)                  ; on from the row after the run
1997+ F414 4F                   ld c,a
1998+ F415 21 5B F4             ld hl,fb_end
1999+ F418 3D                   dec a
2000+ F419 BE                   cp (hl)
2001+ F41A 38 87                jr c,.run
2002+ F41C 3A 5B F4             ld a,(fb_end)                   ; the rest as spans
2003+ F41F 3C                   inc a
2004+ F420 32 61 F4             ld (fb_upto),a
2005+ F423 CD 2E F4             call fb_spans
2006+ F426 3A 62 F4             ld a,(fb_rect)                  ; the spans' flags back, if a
2007+ F429 B7                   or a                            ; rectangle changed them
2008+ F42A C8                   ret z

2047+ F463              ;==============================================================================
2048+ F463              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
2049+ F463              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
2050+ F463              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
2051+ F463              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
2052+ F463              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.

2162+ F592              ; The rows the cell walks can skip this frame: row_skip[j - cz + view_r] not
2163+ F592              ; 0 if every cell in row j would be skipped by WALK_TRY.  Its tests are
2164+ F592              ; linear along a row (X and Z1 are), so a row is out if both its end cells
2165+ F592              ; (cx -/+ view_r, the walk's starts) are past the same edge: right, X - Z1 >=
2166+ F592              ; WALK_R; left, -X - Z1 >= WALK_R; behind, -Z1 >= WALK_R (pitched: only
2167+ F592              ; behind, as WALK_TRY).  So the camera column's cell, which the walks try
2168+ F592              ; without WALK_TRY, is out too.  X = dx cosY - dz sinY, Z1 = dx sinY + dz
2169+ F592              ; cosY, by fmul as row_start's rot_yaw, the dz terms stepped by sinY and
2170+ F592              ; cosY a row (fmul(256, f) is f exactly); ROW_M covers the rounding (each
2171+ F592              ; of these and the walk's own within 2).
2172+ F592              ROW_M           equ 8
2173+ F592              row_cull:

2886+ FB4E              ; scale_comp, step for step), so the same pixels, in one routine: Z's shift
2887+ FB4E              ; chosen by a branch (three ways) rather than patched in, X and Y made

   2+ 8000              ; Z-POLICE - the second city page (8K page PAGE_CITY2, runs at $8000 in slot
   3+ 8000              ; 4: CITY2_MMU)
   4+ 8000              ;
   5+ 8000              ; More of the Layer 2 drawing, paged in beside the city page (slot 7) for the
   6+ 8000              ; city part of each frame: main_loop maps it over the ULA screen after
   7+ 8000              ; clear_screen and puts the ULA screen back before draw_hud.  Nothing in that
   8+ 8000              ; part of the frame uses the ULA screen (the video hardware shows it from
   9+ 8000              ; bank 5 whatever the CPU has mapped), and the interrupt routine uses only
  10+ 8000              ; slots 1 and 5, so interrupts stay on.  Both pages are mapped together, so
  11+ 8000              ; code and data in either call or use the other directly (labels are global).
  12+ 8000              ;
  13+ 8000              ; Here: the street dots, the bullets, rockets and particles, the gunsight and
  14+ 8000              ; the occlusion culling.  Their variables stay in the city page.  Anything
  15+ 8000              ; that calls into this page from outside main_loop's city part must map it
  16+ 8000              ; first (nextreg CITY2_MMU,PAGE_CITY2) and put the ULA screen back after.
  17+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

  20+ 8000              ; Street intersection markers - one dot per grid corner near the camera
  21+ 8000              ; whose 4 cells are all open: no building, terrace or pad cell touches it
  22+ 8000              ; (out of bounds counts as open: it is never drawn).  A corner a building
  23+ 8000              ; touches is always drawn over by it (its faces cover their own corners, and
  24+ 8000              ; the box hides those behind it), so it isn't worked out at all.
  25+ 8000              ;   A row's corners have cells j-1 above and j below; each corner shares its
  26+ 8000              ; left pair of cells with the corner before, so one pair is read a corner.
  27+ 8000              ; An open corner's (X, Z1) is its row's first corner's (worked out once, by
  28+ 8000              ; full rotation, only if the row has an open corner) + k (cosY, sinY), k its
  29+ 8000              ; column in the row: exactly what stepping +256 world units k times gives.

 857+ 85EB
 858+ 85EB                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
 859+ 85EB              ;==============================================================================
 860+ 85EB              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL; pitched too with OCC_PITCHED, up to
 861+ 85EB              ; OCC_PMAX: then the columns are tilted, see occ_test and occ_pretest.pit)
 862+ 85EB              ;
 863+ 85EB              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
 864+ 85EB              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
 865+ 85EB              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
 866+ 85EB              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
 867+ 85EB              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
 868+ 85EB              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
 869+ 85EB              ;     that row - it is dropped;
 870+ 85EB              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
 871+ 85EB              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
 872+ 85EB              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
 873+ 85EB              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
 874+ 85EB              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
 875+ 85EB              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
 876+ 85EB              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
 877+ 85EB              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
 878+ 85EB              ;==============================================================================
 879+ 85EB              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
 880+ 85EB              OCC_YBUF8       equ $4200       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
 881+ 85EB                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (its own page, before the
 882+ 85EB                                              ; records), so a hidden test can pass 8
 883+ 85EB                                              ; columns at once
 884+ 85EB              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
 885+ 85EB              OCC_REC0        equ $43         ; the records' first page; two records a
 886+ 85EB              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; page (128 bytes each, at +0 and +128), up
 887+ 85EB                                              ; to $5F: 58 records ($6000 on: city_col).
 888+ 85EB                                              ; The busiest street view at the full draw
 889+ 85EB                                              ; distance (8 tiles) keeps 35.
 890+ 85EB              ; Record: copy of vtx's 8 corners, bytes 0-8 of each 16 (X, Y, Z, outcode,
 891+ 85EB              ; sx, sy), at the same offsets from the record's start, and in the first
 892+ 85EB              ; corner's spare bytes
 893+ 85EB              OR_VIS          equ 9           ; bld_vis, bld_mx, bld_mz, col_x, col_z, col_top,
 894+ 85EB              OR_N            equ 7           ;   bld_cut
 895+ 85EB                      ASSERT OR_VIS + OR_N <= 16
 896+ 85EB                      ASSERT bld_cut == bld_vis + OR_N - 1
 897+ 85EB                      ASSERT low OCC_YBUF8 == 0       ; (occ_cut: the low byte is the group)
 898+ 85EB              ; A record in a page's upper half is drawn with the +128 corner lists
 899+ 85EB              ; (face_set = FACE_SET2, city.asm).
 900+ 85EB              ; A list entry is a record's address ($4300-$5FFF), a cell with humans as
 901+ 85EB              ; its city_col address ($6000-$6FFF) or a cell with zombies as its city_map
 902+ 85EB              ; address ($7000-$7FFF).
 903+ 85EB
 904+ 85EB              ; Start of the city: occlusion on in level flight (and with OCC_PITCHED
 905+ 85EB              ; up to OCC_PMAX)
 906+ 85EB              occ_begin:
 907+ 85EB AF                   xor a
 908+ 85EC 32 88 FD             ld (occ_on),a
 909+ 85EF 32 89 FD             ld (occ_full),a
 910+ 85F2                  IFNDEF OCC_PITCHED
 911+ 85F2 ~                    ld a,(pitch)
 912+ 85F2 ~                    or a
 913+ 85F2 ~                    ret nz
 914+ 85F2                  ELSE
 915+ 85F2 3A 8A AD             ld a,(pitch)                    ; pitched past OCC_PMAX: the plain way
 916+ 85F5 CB 7F                bit 7,a                         ; (the sides lean too far, the bounds
 917+ 85F7 28 02                jr z,.pp                        ; are loose: it costs more than it
 918+ 85F9 ED 44                neg                             ; saves)
 919+ 85FB FE 13        .pp:    cp OCC_PMAX+1
 920+ 85FD D0                   ret nc
 921+ 85FE 21 78 01             ld hl,2*OCC_R                   ; occ_pretest's pitched bounds
 922+ 8601 ED 5B 92 B4          ld de,(cos_p)
 923+ 8605 CD 46 AD             call fmul
 924+ 8608 22 9D FD             ld (o_kc),hl                    ; 2R cosP
 925+ 860B 21 78 01             ld hl,2*OCC_R
 926+ 860E ED 5B 90 B4          ld de,(sin_p)
 927+ 8612 CD 46 AD             call fmul
 928+ 8615 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 929+ 8617 20 03                jr nz,.ks
 930+ 8619 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 931+ 861C 22 9F FD     .ks:    ld (o_ks),hl                    ; min(0, 2R sinP)
 932+ 861F AF                   xor a
 933+ 8620                  ENDIF

 935+ 8621 32 88 FD             ld (occ_on),a
 936+ 8624 21 00 41             ld hl,OCC_LIST
 937+ 8627 22 8A FD             ld (occ_lp),hl

1827+ 8C1A              ; The figures (zombies, special monsters, humans): their graphics are in

   2++8C77              ; spr_draw for the real-hardware build (REAL_HARDWARE, included by city2.asm):
   3++8C77              ; the graphics are ZPDATA/SPRITEHW.ZPG's, each level a rectangle (zw x zh
   4++8C77              ; bytes, row by row, 0 transparent: tools/spritefile.py), so a figure is one
   5++8C77              ; DMA+ transfer (docs/ZXNDDMA.md): 2D, transparent (pixel 0 not written),
   6++8C77              ; both ends by physical address (no paging: the source page spr_pg, the
   7++8C77              ; buffer being drawn at seg_base), cut to the view: the rows (zy can be off
   8++8C77              ; the top or the bottom) and the columns (the screen's edges).  Mirrored
   9++8C77              ; (zface bit 1), port B counts down along each row.  One colour (spr_col not
  10++8C77              ; 0: the fading ghost) can't be a copy: the CPU draws the same rectangle.
  11++8C77              ; Draws what the plain build's spr_draw does (tests/test_hardware.py).

   1++8DF1              ;==============================================================================
   2++8DF1              ; Z-POLICE - drawing the devil, the final boss (devil.asm), and its
   3++8DF1              ; lightning: part of the second city page (city2.asm includes it), with the
   4++8DF1              ; city page in slot 7, the zombie page in slot 1 and Layer 2 through slot 0
   5++8DF1              ;
   6++8DF1              ; The devil is far bigger than the figures' graphics go (GFX_MAX_H rows), so
   7++8DF1              ; it is scaled as it is drawn, from its DEVIL_W x DEVIL_SRC_H frame (one 8K
   8++8DF1              ; page each, the devil's graphics from the kept figures' pages on:
   9++8DF1              ; devil_load), mapped at $C000 in slot 6:
  10++8DF1              ;   * its feet, its head (DEVIL_H above them) and the ground under it are
  11++8DF1              ;     projected one by one (16 bits: it can be many times the view's height
  12++8DF1              ;     close to);
  13++8DF1              ;   * its width is DV_WU at its feet's distance;
  14++8DF1              ;   * each screen column in view gets its frame column (mirrored for facing
  15++8DF1              ;     right) in four tables, DV_CTAB, one for each of the four frame rows a
  16++8DF1              ;     256-byte step holds (+0, +64, +128, +192: a row is 64 bytes);
  17++8DF1              ;   * each screen row in view, from its top down to its feet or the ground,
  18++8DF1              ;     whichever is higher (it sinks into the ground killed), is its frame row,
  19++8DF1              ;     the pixels through the table for that row's step: 0 transparent.
  20++8DF1              ; Where it was drawn is noted for the missile lock (+31..+33, as fig_seen)
  21++8DF1              ; and its eyes' place for the lightning (dv_seen, dv_ex, dv_ey).
  22++8DF1              ;==============================================================================
  23++8DF1
  24++8DF1              DV_ZMIN         equ 48              ; its feet nearer than this (Z): not drawn
  25++8DF1              DV_FAR          equ 16000           ; a row far off the view (sums stay in 16 bits)
  26++8DF1                      ASSERT DEVIL_H*2*128/DV_ZMIN + DV_FAR < 32768
  27++8DF1              DV_WU           equ DEVIL_H*DEVIL_W/DEVIL_SRC_H     ; its width (world units)
  28++8DF1              DV_EYE_ROW      equ 20              ; its eyes' row in its frame
  29++8DF1              BOLT_SEGS       equ 8               ; the lightning: lines from its eyes
  30++8DF1              BOLT_JIT        equ 16              ;   to the VTOL, the points between
  31++8DF1                                                  ;   jittered up to half this either way
  32++8DF1                      ASSERT DEVIL_W == 64 && DEVIL_SRC_H == 128
  33++8DF1

   1+ 4000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 4000              ; Z-POLICE - Layer 2 320x256 graphics (8K page PAGE_L320, runs at $4000 in
   3+ 4000              ; slot 2)
   4+ 4000              ;
   5+ 4000              ; For the screens outside the game: the menus, the load-out, level complete
   6+ 4000              ; and game over.  They're mostly text, so they use Layer 2's 320x256 mode
   7+ 4000              ; (40 x 32 characters of 8x8, the whole screen, border included) in place of
   8+ 4000              ; the ULA.  This page has everything they draw with:
   9+ 4000              ;   l320_mode320 / l320_mode256   switch the display to 320x256 / back to the
  10+ 4000              ;                                 game's 256x192
  11+ 4000              ;   l320_screen                   a screen's start: cleared, framed, shown
  12+ 4000              ;                                 (screen320, text.asm, calls it)
  13+ 4000              ;   l320_cls                      clear the screen to a colour (by DMA)
  14+ 4000              ;   l320_at, l320_pos             set the text position (character / pixel)
  15+ 4000              ;   l320_char, l320_print,        text: one character, a string (with colour
  16+ 4000              ;   l320_print_at,                  and position codes), a string at a row
  17+ 4000              ;   l320_print_list                 and column (menu_print's registers), a
  18+ 4000              ;                                   table of strings
  19+ 4000              ;   l320_recolour, l320_swap      change colours already drawn: a run of
  20+ 4000              ;                                 text cells (highlighting), or one colour in
  21+ 4000              ;                                 a box
  22+ 4000              ;   l320_plot, l320_line,         pixels, lines, filled boxes, outlines
  23+ 4000              ;   l320_fill, l320_hline,
  24+ 4000              ;   l320_vline, l320_box
  25+ 4000              ;
  26+ 4000              ; Use: page it in, switch, clear, draw:
  27+ 4000              ;       nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320      ; this page at $4000 (slot 2)
  28+ 4000              ;       ld a,L320_BLACK
  29+ 4000              ;       call l320_cls
  30+ 4000              ;       call l320_mode320
  31+ 4000              ; and on leaving for the game, switch back and put the occlusion page back
  32+ 4000              ; in slot 2 (l2_game_mode, zpolice.asm, does both).
  33+ 4000              ;
  34+ 4000              ; Slot 2 is the occlusion data's, used only while the city is drawn, so it
  35+ 4000              ; is free on these screens: they run in slot 6, with the keys (and the
  36+ 4000              ; sprites, sound, file handler) in slot 7, the resident page in slot 5, the
  37+ 4000              ; zombie page (and the IM 2 table) in slot 1 and the city bank in slot 3.
  38+ 4000              ;
  39+ 4000              ; The screen: 5 16K banks from L2_BANK_A (banks 9-13, pages 18-27: the first
  40+ 4000              ; game buffer and part of the second, unused while these screens are up;
  41+ 4000              ; the game clears both before it draws).  320x256 is column-major: pixel
  42+ 4000              ; (x, y) is byte x*256 + y, so each 8K page is 32 columns of 256 pixels and
  43+ 4000              ; a column's pixels are in one page.  Writes go through slot 0, as the game's
  44+ 4000              ; do: (x, y) is page 18 + x/32, at $0000 + (x & 31)*256 + y.
  45+ 4000              ;
  46+ 4000              ; Colours: Layer 2's second palette, set to RRRGGGBB (the colour is the
  47+ 4000              ; byte; the level's palette is the first one and is left alone).  $E3 is
  48+ 4000              ; the transparency colour: it is never drawn, and as a paper it means "leave
  49+ 4000              ; the background" (L320_NOPAPER).
  50+ 4000              ;
  51+ 4000              ; Registers: every routine may change AF, BC, DE, HL unless it says so; IX,
  52+ 4000              ; IY and the alternate set are kept.  The text uses the resident 8x8 font
  53+ 4000              ; (font8, text.asm: ASCII 32-95; lower case is drawn as upper case).
  54+ 4000              ;==============================================================================
  55+ 4000

 612+ 4306              ; Load file name to buf (at most size bytes); ok := 1 if its header is head
 613+ 4306              ; (10 bytes), its gradients 1..F12_GRAD_MAX of rows+1 bytes each, and its
 614+ 4306              ; size the header, glyphs bytes and the gradients'
 615+ 4306                  MACRO FONT_LOAD FLNAME, FLBUF, FLSIZE, FLHEAD, FLGLYPHS, FLROWS, FLOK
 616+ 4306 ~                    xor a
 617+ 4306 ~                    ld (FLOK),a
 618+ 4306 ~                    nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
 619+ 4306 ~                    ld hl,FLNAME
 620+ 4306 ~                    ld de,FLBUF
 621+ 4306 ~                    ld bc,FLSIZE+1                  ; (one more: a longer file isn't one)
 622+ 4306 ~                    call fh_load

 624+ 4306 ~                    ret c                           ; none
 625+ 4306 ~                    ld (f12_len),bc                 ; (the bytes read)
 626+ 4306 ~                    ld hl,FLBUF                     ; the header

 629+ 4306 ~            .h:     ld a,(de)

 637+ 4306 ~                    ret z
 638+ 4306 ~                    cp F12_GRAD_MAX+1
 639+ 4306 ~                    ret nc
 640+ 4306 ~                    ld e,a                          ; the size: header, glyphs, gradients
 641+ 4306 ~                    ld d,1+FLROWS

 644+ 4306 ~                    add hl,de

 646+ 4306 ~                    or a
 647+ 4306 ~                    sbc hl,bc
 648+ 4306 ~                    ret nz
 649+ 4306 ~                    ld a,1
 650+ 4306 ~                    ld (FLOK),a
 651+ 4306 ~                    ret
 652+ 4306                  ENDM

 322+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 323+ E200              ; Weapon slots: a column for each, at columns WPN_COL0, +2, ... in the order
 324+ E200              ; wpn_order (as numbered on keys 1-5: 2 4 1 5 3).  From the top:
 325+ E200              ;   * row WPN_NUM_ROW: its slot number, yellow if selected; none if unused;
 326+ E200              ;   * rows WPN_ROW..: a bar 1 character wide and WPN_BAR high, its ammo one
 327+ E200              ;     digit a row in black, hundreds at the top (infinite ammo: INF).  Green;
 328+ E200              ;     red with no ammo left; black if unused.  An unused slot that was asked
 329+ E200              ;     for flashes amber / black (WFLASH frames each, 3 times);
 330+ E200              ;   * row WPN_LTR_ROW: the letter of its weapon (wpn_glyph), yellow if
 331+ E200              ;     selected.
 332+ E200              ; The selected slot also has a yellow line above and below the bar, in the
 333+ E200              ; number's and the letter's cells (a cell has one ink: in the bar's they
 334+ E200              ; would be black).  Checked every frame, redrawn only when it changes
 335+ E200              ; (wd_shown).
 336+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 337+ E200              WPN_ATTR_ON     equ C_OK<<3             ; paper green, ink black
 338+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OUT    equ C_WARN<<3           ; paper red
 339+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OFF    equ P_EMPTY<<3          ; paper black
 340+ E200              WPN_ATTR_FLASH  equ C_AMBER<<3          ; paper amber
 341+ E200              WPN_NUM_ATTR    equ P_PANEL<<3 | 7
 342+ E200              WPN_SEL_ATTR    equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_YEL
 343+ E200              WPN_BMP         equ ULA_BMP + (WPN_ROW/8)*$800 + (WPN_ROW&7)*32 + WPN_COL0
 344+ E200                      ASSERT WPN_NUM_ROW/8 == WPN_LTR_ROW/8   ; the rows in one third
 345+ E200                      ASSERT WPN_COL0 + 2*(WPN_SLOTS-1) < MAP_COL
