   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000
  38+ E000              ; --- key codes: bank << 8 | mask ---------------------------------------------
  39+ E000              KB_SHIFT    equ $0001                   ; bank 0: $FEFE

 151+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 152+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every
 153+ E000              ; bit 1 = pressed
 154+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 155+ E000              kbd_scan:
 156+ E000 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 157+ E003 11 63 E1             ld de,key_prev
 158+ E006 01 0D 00             ld bc,KEY_BANKS
 159+ E009 ED B0                ldir
 160+ E00B 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 161+ E00E 01 FE FE             ld bc,$FEFE                     ; banks 0-7: half-rows $FE..$7F
 162+ E011 ED 78        .row:   in a,(c)
 163+ E013 2F                   cpl                             ; 0 = pressed -> 1 = pressed
 164+ E014 E6 1F                and %00011111
 165+ E016 77                   ld (hl),a
 166+ E017 23                   inc hl
 167+ E018 CB 00                rlc b                           ; next half-row
 168+ E01A 38 F5                jr c,.row                       ; (stops after $7F)
 169+ E01C 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; banks 8, 9: NextRegs $B0, $B1
 170+ E01F 3E B0                ld a,$B0
 171+ E021 ED 79                out (c),a
 172+ E023 04                   inc b
 173+ E024 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; already 1 = pressed
 174+ E026 77                   ld (hl),a
 175+ E027 23                   inc hl
 176+ E028 05                   dec b
 177+ E029 3E B1                ld a,$B1
 178+ E02B ED 79                out (c),a
 179+ E02D 04                   inc b
 180+ E02E ED 78                in a,(c)
 181+ E030 77                   ld (hl),a
 182+ E031 23                   inc hl
 183+ E032                      ; banks 10-12, the joysticks: only the ports a joystick is set to
 184+ E032                      ; (NextReg $05), so an unused port can't read as all pressed
 185+ E032 05                   dec b                           ; (BC = $243B)
 186+ E033 3E 05                ld a,$05
 187+ E035 ED 79                out (c),a
 188+ E037 04                   inc b

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 42          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 2A                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 2A                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret
 112+ E043
 113+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 114+ E043              ; Load B 8-bit patterns (256 bytes each) from HL into pattern memory, from
 115+ E043              ; pattern A (0..63).  HL ends past them.
 116+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 117+ E043              spr_patterns:
 118+ E043 50                   ld d,b
 119+ E044 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 120+ E047 ED 79                out (c),a
 121+ E049 0E 5B                ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT
 122+ E04B 06 00        .lp:    ld b,0                          ; 256 bytes
 123+ E04D ED B3                otir
 124+ E04F 15                   dec d
 125+ E050 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 126+ E052 C9                   ret
 127+ E053
 128+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129+ E053              ; Load B colours (8-bit RRRGGGBB) from HL into the sprite palette, from
 130+ E053              ; index A.  (It starts as the identity: only needed for other colours.)
 131+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 132+ E053              spr_palette:
 133+ E053 ED 91 43 20          nextreg $43,%00100000           ; edit the first sprite palette
 134+ E057 ED 92 40             nextreg $40,a
 135+ E05A 7E           .lp:    ld a,(hl)
 136+ E05B ED 92 41             nextreg $41,a
 137+ E05E 23                   inc hl
 138+ E05F 10 F9                djnz .lp
 139+ E061 C9                   ret
 140+ E062
 141+ E062              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 142+ E062              ; Sprite A (0..SPR_COUNT-1) in the shadow table.  BC = x, DE = y (sprite
 143+ E062              ; screen, signed 9 bits), H = pattern (0..63), L = flags (SPRF_*).  Shows it.
 144+ E062              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 145+ E062              spr_set:
 146+ E062 22 08 E1             ld (spr_pf),hl
 147+ E065 F5                   push af
 148+ E066 CD 84 E0             call spr_pos
 149+ E069 F1                   pop af
 150+ E06A CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 151+ E06D 23                   inc hl
 152+ E06E 23                   inc hl                          ; +2: the flags, keeping x bit 8
 153+ E06F 3A 08 E1             ld a,(spr_pf)
 154+ E072 E6 FE                and $FE
 155+ E074 5F                   ld e,a
 156+ E075 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 157+ E076 E6 01                and 1
 158+ E078 B3                   or e
 159+ E079 77                   ld (hl),a
 160+ E07A 23                   inc hl                          ; +3: visible, 5-byte form, pattern
 161+ E07B 3A 09 E1             ld a,(spr_pf+1)
 162+ E07E E6 3F                and $3F
 163+ E080 F6 C0                or $C0
 164+ E082 77                   ld (hl),a
 165+ E083 C9                   ret
 166+ E084
 167+ E084              ; Sprite A: move to BC = x, DE = y (signed 9 bits)
 168+ E084              spr_pos:
 169+ E084 D5                   push de
 170+ E085 CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 171+ E088 D1                   pop de
 172+ E089 71                   ld (hl),c                       ; +0 x bits 0-7
 173+ E08A 23                   inc hl
 174+ E08B 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; +1 y bits 0-7
 175+ E08C 23                   inc hl
 176+ E08D 78                   ld a,b                          ; +2 bit 0: x bit 8
 177+ E08E E6 01                and 1
 178+ E090 47                   ld b,a
 179+ E091 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 180+ E092 E6 FE                and $FE
 181+ E094 B0                   or b
 182+ E095 77                   ld (hl),a
 183+ E096 23                   inc hl
 184+ E097 23                   inc hl
 185+ E098 7A                   ld a,d                          ; +4 bit 0: y bit 8
 186+ E099 E6 01                and 1
 187+ E09B 57                   ld d,a
 188+ E09C 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 189+ E09D E6 FE                and $FE
 190+ E09F B2                   or d
 191+ E0A0 77                   ld (hl),a
 192+ E0A1 C9                   ret
 193+ E0A2
 194+ E0A2              ; Sprite A: pattern E (0..63), keeping whether it is shown
 195+ E0A2              spr_pattern:
 196+ E0A2 CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 197+ E0A5 7D                   ld a,l
 198+ E0A6 C6 03                add a,3
 199+ E0A8 6F                   ld l,a
 200+ E0A9 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 201+ E0AA E6 C0                and $C0
 202+ E0AC B3                   or e
 203+ E0AD 77                   ld (hl),a
 204+ E0AE C9                   ret
 205+ E0AF
 206+ E0AF              ; Sprite A: flags E (SPRF_*: palette offset, mirrors, rotation)
 207+ E0AF              spr_flags:
 208+ E0AF CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 209+ E0B2 23                   inc hl
 210+ E0B3 23                   inc hl
 211+ E0B4 7B                   ld a,e
 212+ E0B5 E6 FE                and $FE
 213+ E0B7 5F                   ld e,a
 214+ E0B8 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 215+ E0B9 E6 01                and 1
 216+ E0BB B3                   or e
 217+ E0BC 77                   ld (hl),a
 218+ E0BD C9                   ret
 219+ E0BE
 220+ E0BE              ; Sprite A: scale E across, D down (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8)
 221+ E0BE              spr_scale:
 222+ E0BE D5                   push de
 223+ E0BF CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 224+ E0C2 D1                   pop de
 225+ E0C3 7D                   ld a,l
 226+ E0C4 C6 04                add a,4
 227+ E0C6 6F                   ld l,a
 228+ E0C7 7B                   ld a,e
 229+ E0C8 E6 03                and 3
 230+ E0CA 07                   rlca
 231+ E0CB 07                   rlca
 232+ E0CC 5F                   ld e,a
 233+ E0CD 7A                   ld a,d
 234+ E0CE E6 03                and 3
 235+ E0D0 B3                   or e
 236+ E0D1 07                   rlca                            ; x scale bits 4-3, y scale 2-1
 237+ E0D2 5F                   ld e,a
 238+ E0D3 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 239+ E0D4 E6 01                and 1                           ; (keep y bit 8)
 240+ E0D6 B3                   or e
 241+ E0D7 77                   ld (hl),a
 242+ E0D8 C9                   ret
 243+ E0D9
 244+ E0D9              ; Sprite A: hide / show
 245+ E0D9              spr_hide:
 246+ E0D9 CD F7 E0             call spr_addr3
 247+ E0DC CB BE                res 7,(hl)
 248+ E0DE C9                   ret
 249+ E0DF              spr_show:
 250+ E0DF CD F7 E0             call spr_addr3
 251+ E0E2 CB FE                set 7,(hl)
 252+ E0E4 C9                   ret
 253+ E0E5
 254+ E0E5              ; Hide every sprite in the table
 255+ E0E5              spr_hide_all:
 256+ E0E5 AF                   xor a                           ; (the viewport's frame: set it again)
 257+ E0E6 32 2C E4             ld (frm_on),a
 258+ E0E9 21 03 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow+3
 259+ E0EC 11 05 00             ld de,SPR_ATTR
 260+ E0EF 06 2A                ld b,SPR_COUNT
 261+ E0F1 CB BE        .lp:    res 7,(hl)
 262+ E0F3 19                   add hl,de
 263+ E0F4 10 FB                djnz .lp
 264+ E0F6 C9                   ret
 265+ E0F7
 266+ E0F7              ; A = sprite -> HL -> its attributes in the table, +3 for spr_addr3.
 267+ E0F7              ; (The table doesn't cross a 256-byte boundary, so +n is just L + n.)
 268+ E0F7              spr_addr3:
 269+ E0F7 CD FE E0             call spr_addr
 270+ E0FA 23                   inc hl
 271+ E0FB 23                   inc hl
 272+ E0FC 23                   inc hl
 273+ E0FD C9                   ret
 274+ E0FE              spr_addr:
 275+ E0FE 57                   ld d,a
 276+ E0FF 1E 05                ld e,SPR_ATTR
 277+ E101 ED 30                mul d,e
 278+ E103 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 279+ E106 19                   add hl,de
 280+ E107 C9                   ret
 281+ E108
 282+ E108              ;==============================================================================
 283+ E108              ; Sprite data
 284+ E108              ;==============================================================================
 285+ E108              ; The patterns themselves are in the sprite banks (sprite_data.asm).
 286+ E108              ; Bank 0 has the human status sprites, loaded as patterns 0-3 by
 287+ E108              ; sprites_init, after the HUD's passenger markers:
 288+ E108              ;   HSPR_FIELD   0  waiting in the field, not yet rescued: an empty square
 289+ E108              ;   HSPR_ABOARD  1  aboard the VTOL: a person sitting in a chair
 290+ E108              ;   HSPR_SAVED   2  rescued: a green person standing
 291+ E108              ;   HSPR_DEAD    3  dead: a white person with a red cross over them
 292+ E108
 293+ E108 00 00        spr_pf:     dw 0                        ; spr_set: flags, pattern
 294+ E10A 00 00 00...          ALIGN 256
 295+ E200 00 00 00...  spr_shadow: ds SPR_COUNT*SPR_ATTR       ; attributes, as sent (5-byte form)
 296+ E2D2                      ASSERT SPR_COUNT*SPR_ATTR <= 256

   1+ E2D2              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E2D2              ; Z-POLICE - HUD sprites (in the sprites page, PAGE_SPRITES, at $E000 in slot
   3+ E2D2              ; 7): the human status column and the compass bar, as hardware sprites on
   4+ E2D2              ; the 320 x 256 sprite screen.  hud_sprites sets both and sends the sprite
   5+ E2D2              ; table to the hardware; main_loop calls it once a frame, after the flip.
   6+ E2D2              ;
   7+ E2D2              ; Sprites used: 0..HUMAN_MAX-1 the humans, CSPR_SPR0.. the compass bar's
   8+ E2D2              ; marks, CSPR_PTR_SPR its pointer, FRM_SPR0.. the viewport's frame.
   9+ E2D2              ;==============================================================================
  10+ E2D2
  11+ E2D2              hud_sprites:
  12+ E2D2 3A 2C E4             ld a,(frm_on)                   ; the frame, once (they stay set)
  13+ E2D5 B7                   or a
  14+ E2D6 CC 32 E3             call z,frame_spr
  15+ E2D9 CD D5 E3             call hum_hud
  16+ E2DC CD 6A E3             call compass_spr
  17+ E2DF C3 2E E0             jp spr_update
  18+ E2E2
  19+ E2E2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  20+ E2E2              ; The viewport's frame: curved corners and edges in hardware sprites, over
  21+ E2E2              ; Layer 2 and the border, so nothing is drawn into the view.  Set once after
  22+ E2E2              ; the sprites are hidden (frm_on; spr_hide_all clears it).  frame_tab: x, y,
  23+ E2E2              ; pattern and flags, then scale across and down: the edges are 1-row patterns
  24+ E2E2              ; stretched, FRM_H across (two at x8 overlapping, 224 pixels) and FRM_V down
  25+ E2E2              ; (two at x4 overlapping, 96).  (The panel's bottom corners aren't rounded:
  26+ E2E2              ; sprites there covered the city map's bottom left.)
  27+ E2E2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  28+ E2E2              FRM_SPR0        equ CSPR_PTR_SPR+1  ; the frame's sprites (10)
  29+ E2E2              FRM_L           equ SPR_SCREEN_X
  30+ E2E2              FRM_R           equ SPR_SCREEN_X+256-SPR_SIZE
  31+ E2E2              FRM_T           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y
  32+ E2E2              FRM_B           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y+VIEW_H-SPR_SIZE
  33+ E2E2              FRM_X8          equ 3               ; (scale codes)
  34+ E2E2              FRM_X4          equ 2
  35+ E2E2              FRM_REC         equ 8
  36+ E2E2
  37+ E2E2              frame_tab:
  38+ E2E2 20 00 20 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_T
  39+ E2E6 0B 00 00 00          db FRM_CRN, 0, 0, 0
  40+ E2EA 10 01 20 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_T
  41+ E2EE 0B 08 00 00          db FRM_CRN, SPRF_XMIRROR, 0, 0
  42+ E2F2 20 00 90 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_B
  43+ E2F6 0C 04 00 00          db FRM_CRN_P, SPRF_YMIRROR, 0, 0
  44+ E2FA 10 01 90 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_B
  45+ E2FE 0C 0C 00 00          db FRM_CRN_P, SPRF_XMIRROR|SPRF_YMIRROR, 0, 0
  46+ E302 30 00 20 00          dw FRM_L+SPR_SIZE, FRM_T                ; the top edge
  47+ E306 0E 00 03 00          db FRM_H, 0, FRM_X8, 0
  48+ E30A 90 00 20 00          dw FRM_R-16*8, FRM_T
  49+ E30E 0E 00 03 00          db FRM_H, 0, FRM_X8, 0
  50+ E312 20 00 30 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_T+SPR_SIZE                ; the left edge
  51+ E316 0F 00 00 02          db FRM_V, 0, 0, FRM_X4
  52+ E31A 20 00 50 00          dw FRM_L, FRM_B-16*4
  53+ E31E 0F 00 00 02          db FRM_V, 0, 0, FRM_X4
  54+ E322 10 01 30 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_T+SPR_SIZE                ; the right edge
  55+ E326 0F 08 00 02          db FRM_V, SPRF_XMIRROR, 0, FRM_X4
  56+ E32A 10 01 50 00          dw FRM_R, FRM_B-16*4
  57+ E32E 0F 08 00 02          db FRM_V, SPRF_XMIRROR, 0, FRM_X4
  58+ E332              frame_tab_end:
  59+ E332              FRM_COUNT       equ (frame_tab_end-frame_tab)/FRM_REC
  60+ E332                      ASSERT FRM_SPR0+FRM_COUNT == SPR_COUNT
  61+ E332
  62+ E332              frame_spr:

  64+ E334 32 2C E4             ld (frm_on),a
  65+ E337 DD 21 E2 E2          ld ix,frame_tab

  68+ E33E DD 4E 00             ld c,(ix+0)

  70+ E344 DD 5E 02             ld e,(ix+2)

  85+ E367 20 D4                jr nz,.lp
  86+ E369 C9                   ret

  88+ E36A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ E36A              ; The compass bar, across the top of the screen in the top border (sprite
  90+ E36A              ; row COMP_SPR_Y): a tape of marks every 16 yaw units (22.5 degrees), at 2
  91+ E36A              ; pixels a yaw unit, centred on the heading at sprite x COMP_SPR_CX, across
  92+ E36A              ; the full 320-pixel width of the sprite screen: 225 degrees (+-COMP_HALF,
  93+ E36A              ; 80 yaw units).  Marks at the very edges are half off the screen (their x
  94+ E36A              ; wraps, as sprite x does).  The letters N,
  95+ E36A              ; E, S, W (red) at 0, 64, 128, 192; a yellow dot at the 45 degree points;
  96+ E36A              ; a small white dot between.  A white pointer under the bar's middle marks
  97+ E36A              ; the heading.  Turning right (yaw up) moves the marks left.
  98+ E36A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  99+ E36A              CSPR_SPR0       equ HUMAN_MAX       ; first compass mark sprite (20)
 100+ E36A              COMP_HALF       equ 80              ; yaw units shown either side: 160 px
 101+ E36A              CSPR_MARKS      equ 2*COMP_HALF/16+1    ; most marks in view at once (11)
 102+ E36A              CSPR_PTR_SPR    equ CSPR_SPR0+CSPR_MARKS   ; the pointer's sprite
 103+ E36A              COMP_SPR_Y      equ 8               ; the bar's sprite row
 104+ E36A              COMP_PTR_Y      equ COMP_SPR_Y+SPR_SIZE    ; the pointer, under it
 105+ E36A              COMP_SPR_CX     equ 160             ; the heading's x: the screen's middle
 106+ E36A              COMP_SPR_X0     equ COMP_SPR_CX-2*COMP_HALF-SPR_SIZE/2  ; x of a mark =
 107+ E36A                                                  ; this + 2 * (COMP_HALF + mark - yaw)
 108+ E36A                      ASSERT CSPR_PTR_SPR < SPR_COUNT
 109+ E36A                      ASSERT CSPR_E == CSPR_N+1 && CSPR_S == CSPR_N+2 && CSPR_W == CSPR_N+3

# file opened: file_handler.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;   fh_mkdir     HL = name: make the folder (its parent must exist; carry,
  43+ E000              ;                A = the error, if it can't: it's there already, say)
  44+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ E000
  46+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  47+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  48+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  49+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  50+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  51+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  52+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  53+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  54+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  55+ E000              F_MKDIR         equ $AA
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  58+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  59+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  60+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  61+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  62+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  63+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  64+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  65+ E000
  66+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  67+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  68+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  69+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  72+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  73+ E000
  74+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  75+ E000
  76+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  77+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  78+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  79+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  81+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  82+ E000 ~                    db fn
  83+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  84+ E000                      ENDM

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08), and the
   8+ E000              ; engines' chip, AY 1, to mono (NextReg $09: its three channels in the
   9+ E000              ; centre, AY_MONO_ENGINES), the effects' chips stereo.  init_audio then sets every chip to a
  10+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_quiet).
  11+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  12+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  13+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  14+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2's A and B), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B), ld
  15+ E000              ; (sfx3_req),a (AY 3's C) or ld (sfx4_req),a (AY 2's C: the base's
  16+ E000              ; warnings), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  17+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  18+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  19+ E000              ;
  20+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  21+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  22+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  23+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  24+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  25+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  26+ E000
  27+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  28+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  29+ E000
  30+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  31+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  32+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  33+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  35+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  36+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  37+ E000              ; NextReg $09 (Peripheral 4) bits 5-7 put the hardware's AY 0, 1, 2 in mono:
  38+ E000              ; select %11 is its AY 0, the game's AY 1 (the engines), so bit 5
  39+ E000              AY_MONO_ENGINES equ %00100000
  40+ E000                      ASSERT AY_CHIP_1 == %11
  41+ E000
  42+ E000              ; AY registers
  43+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  44+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  45+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  46+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  47+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  48+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  49+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  50+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  51+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  52+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  53+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000

  55+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  56+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  57+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  58+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  59+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  60+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  61+ E000
  62+ E000              AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD equ %1101        ; envelope: rise once, then hold
  63+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  64+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  65+ E000
  66+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  67+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX
  68+ E000              ENG_MIXER       equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  69+ E000                                                  ; A noise only, B and C tone only
  70+ E000              ENG_NOISE0      equ 29              ; A, the roar: noise period 29 - n*13/16
  71+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  72+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)
  73+ E000              ENG_WHINE0      equ 222             ; B, the turbine whine: period 222 - 3n
  74+ E000              ENG_WHINE_STEP  equ 3               ;   (~500 Hz at idle, ~790 Hz flat out)
  75+ E000              ENG_WHINE_VOL0  equ 2               ;   volume 2 + n*7/32 (2..8)
  76+ E000              ENG_VOL_MUL     equ 7               ; the volumes rise by n*7/32 (0..6)
  77+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  78+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter
  79+ E000              ; Sound effects (sfx_tick, interrupts.asm): their numbers, and the step codes
  80+ E000              SFX_MG          equ 1               ; the machine gun: one round
  81+ E000              SFX_LASER       equ 2               ; the pulse laser: one pulse (a zap)
  82+ E000              SFX_CHAIN       equ 3               ; the chain gun: one round
  83+ E000              SFX_ROCKET      equ 4               ; a rocket fired: a short woosh
  84+ E000              SFX_MISSILE     equ 5               ; a missile fired: a longer woosh
  85+ E000              SFX_AUTOCANNON  equ 6               ; the autocannon / proximity cannon: one shell
  86+ E000              SFX_BOOM_ROCKET equ 7               ; explosions (AY 3, sfx2_req): a rocket's,
  87+ E000              SFX_BOOM_MISSILE equ 8              ;   a missile's,
  88+ E000              SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON equ 9           ;   an autocannon shell's,
  89+ E000              SFX_BOOM_PROX   equ 10              ;   a proximity shell's
  90+ E000              SFX_SPLAT       equ 11              ; a zombie hit (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  91+ E000              SFX_CRASH       equ 12              ; the VTOL hitting a building (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  92+ E000              SFX_LOCK        equ 13              ; the missile lock: a double beep (AY 2)
  93+ E000              SFX_CHARGE      equ 14              ; the devil charging its lightning: a

  97+ E000              SFX_WARN_LOW    equ 16              ; the base's warnings (AY 2 C, sfx4_req):
  98+ E000                                                  ;   a terrace or barricade hit, a low beep;
  99+ E000              SFX_WARN_MID    equ 17              ;   the landing pad hit, a mid one
 100+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 17              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)
 101+ E000              SFX_STEP        equ $FE             ; end of a step: the next, next interrupt
 102+ E000              SFX_END         equ $FF             ; end of the sound
 103+ E000              ; AY 2's mixers keep tone C on (and its noise off): channel C is the
 104+ E000              ; warnings' (voice 4), so the weapons' sounds leave it alone
 105+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 106+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only, B tone only
 107+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 108+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A and B tones only
 109+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 110+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only
 111+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_A  equ AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 112+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A tone only
 113+ E000              SFX_MIX_BOOM    equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 114+ E000                                                  ; AY 3's mixer: A noise, B tone (the
 115+ E000                                                  ; explosions), C tone (the splats)
 116+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
 117+ E000
 118+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 119+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 120+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)
 121+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_SPIN_UP > 0 && ENG_SPIN_DOWN > 0
 122+ E000                      ASSERT -SPEED_MIN <= SPEED_MAX
 123+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE0 - SPEED_MAX*ENG_WHINE_STEP > 0 && ENG_WHINE0 + ENG_DETUNE < 256
 124+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_NOISE0 < 32 && ENG_NOISE0 - (SPEED_MAX*ENG_NOISE_MUL)/16 >= 1
 125+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_ROAR_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15 && ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15
 126+ E000                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL < 256
 127+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_VOL0 >= ENG_SHIMMER_VOL

 130+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 131+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 132+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.

 134+ E000              init_audio:

 142+ E011 6F                   ld l,a
 143+ E012 22 8B 3C             ld (sfx_ptr),hl
 144+ E015 22 8E 3C             ld (sfx2_ptr),hl
 145+ E018 22 91 3C             ld (sfx3_ptr),hl
 146+ E01B 22 94 3C             ld (sfx4_ptr),hl

 148+ E020 CD 2A E0             call ay_init_chip
 149+ E023 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 150+ E025 CD 2A E0             call ay_init_chip

 154+ E02A              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope

 158+ E02F 7A           .clr:   ld a,d

 160+ E032 CD 6B E0             call ay_write

 170+ E047              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 171+ E047              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 172+ E047              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 173+ E047              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 174+ E047              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 175+ E047              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 176+ E047              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 177+ E047              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 178+ E047              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 179+ E047              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 180+ E047              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 181+ E047              engine_start:

 184+ E04B 21 00 00             ld hl,0

 189+ E058 1E 31                ld e,ENG_MIXER
 190+ E05A CD 6B E0             call ay_write
 191+ E05D 3E 01                ld a,1
 192+ E05F 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 193+ E062 C9                   ret
 194+ E063
 195+ E063              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 196+ E063              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 197+ E063              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 198+ E063              ay_select:
 199+ E063 F6 FC                or AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT
 200+ E065 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 201+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 202+ E06A C9                   ret
 203+ E06B
 204+ E06B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 205+ E06B              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 206+ E06B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 207+ E06B              ay_write:
 208+ E06B 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 209+ E06E ED 79                out (c),a
 210+ E070 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 211+ E072 ED 59                out (c),e

# file opened: sound.asm
   1+ E075              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E075              ; Z-POLICE - the sound players (in the audio page, PAGE_AUDIO, with
   3+ E075              ; audio.asm and the sounds, sfx_data.asm): called by the interrupt routine
   4+ E075              ; (im2_routine, interrupts.asm) 50 times a second with this page mapped
   5+ E075              ; into slot 7 for them (the page there put back after).  The game asks for
   6+ E075              ; a sound through the resident request bytes (sfx_req, sfx2_req, sfx3_req:
   7+ E075              ; interrupts.asm), so any page can.
   8+ E075              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E075
  10+ E075              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  11+ E075              ; The VTOL's engines (audio.asm has the sound's constants and engine_start):
  12+ E075              ; jet turbines, on AY 1.  eng_cur is the speed the engines sound at, in
  13+ E075              ; 1/ENG_FRAC steps; each interrupt it follows the VTOL's, n = |speed| (at
  14+ E075              ; least 1: zero throttle idles as speed 1), by at most ENG_SPIN_UP going up
  15+ E075              ; and ENG_SPIN_DOWN going down: the turbines spool up, and down more slowly,
  16+ E075              ; instead of jumping.  From it:
  17+ E075              ;   A  noise, the roar: period ENG_NOISE0 - m*13/16, volume ENG_ROAR_VOL0 +
  18+ E075              ;      m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  19+ E075              ;      (m = eng_cur/ENG_FRAC, whole steps)
  20+ E075              ;   B  tone, the turbine whine: period ENG_WHINE0 - eng_cur*ENG_WHINE_STEP/
  21+ E075              ;      ENG_FRAC (sliding smoothly), volume ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  22+ E075              ;   C  the same whine ENG_DETUNE periods lower and ENG_SHIMMER_VOL quieter:
  23+ E075              ;      the two beat, the turbines' shimmer
  24+ E075              ; Written only when eng_cur moves.  Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
  25+ E075              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  26+ E075              engine_tick:
  27+ E075 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
  28+ E078 B7                   or a
  29+ E079 C8                   ret z
  30+ E07A 3A 8B AD             ld a,(speed)
  31+ E07D B7                   or a
  32+ E07E F2 83 E0             jp p,.pos
  33+ E081 ED 44                neg                             ; reversing: its size
  34+ E083 B7           .pos:   or a
  35+ E084 20 01                jr nz,.n
  36+ E086 3C                   inc a                           ; zero throttle: idle, as speed 1
  37+ E087 FE 1D        .n:     cp SPEED_MAX+1
  38+ E089 38 02                jr c,.nm
  39+ E08B 3E 1C                ld a,SPEED_MAX                  ; (boosting: as flat out)
  40+ E08D 5F           .nm:    ld e,a
  41+ E08E 16 10                ld d,ENG_FRAC
  42+ E090 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = the target, in 1/ENG_FRAC steps
  43+ E092 2A 97 3C             ld hl,(eng_cur)
  44+ E095 B7                   or a
  45+ E096 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; HL = eng_cur - target
  46+ E098 C8                   ret z                           ; there: nothing changes
  47+ E099 38 09                jr c,.up
  48+ E09B 01 FE FF             ld bc,-ENG_SPIN_DOWN            ; above: down a step
  49+ E09E 09                   add hl,bc
  50+ E09F 30 0C                jr nc,.tgt                      ; (less than a step away: there)
  51+ E0A1 19                   add hl,de
  52+ E0A2 18 0A                jr .set
  53+ E0A4 01 04 00     .up:    ld bc,ENG_SPIN_UP               ; below: up a step
  54+ E0A7 09                   add hl,bc
  55+ E0A8 38 03                jr c,.tgt                       ; (reached it)
  56+ E0AA 19                   add hl,de
  57+ E0AB 18 01                jr .set
  58+ E0AD EB           .tgt:   ex de,hl
  59+ E0AE 22 97 3C     .set:   ld (eng_cur),hl
  60+ E0B1 3E FF                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_1
  61+ E0B3 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
  62+ E0B6 ED 79                out (c),a
  63+ E0B8 E5                   push hl
  64+ E0B9 54                   ld d,h                          ; B: the whine's period
  65+ E0BA 5D                   ld e,l
  66+ E0BB 29                   add hl,hl
  67+ E0BC 19                   add hl,de                       ; eng_cur * ENG_WHINE_STEP
  68+ E0BD EB                   ex de,hl
  69+ E0BE 06 04                ld b,4
  70+ E0C0 ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; / ENG_FRAC
  71+ E0C2                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_STEP == 3 && ENG_FRAC == 16
  72+ E0C2 3E DE                ld a,ENG_WHINE0
  73+ E0C4 93                   sub e
  74+ E0C5 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = the whine's period
  75+ E0C6 5F                   ld e,a
  76+ E0C7 3E 02                ld a,AY_TONE_B
  77+ E0C9 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  78+ E0CC 3E 03                ld a,AY_TONE_B+1
  79+ E0CE 1E 00                ld e,0
  80+ E0D0 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  81+ E0D3 7D                   ld a,l                          ; C: a little lower, to beat with B
  82+ E0D4 C6 02                add a,ENG_DETUNE
  83+ E0D6 5F                   ld e,a
  84+ E0D7 3E 04                ld a,AY_TONE_C
  85+ E0D9 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  86+ E0DC 3E 05                ld a,AY_TONE_C+1
  87+ E0DE 1E 00                ld e,0
  88+ E0E0 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  89+ E0E3 D1                   pop de                          ; m = eng_cur / ENG_FRAC
  90+ E0E4 06 04                ld b,4
  91+ E0E6 ED 2A                bsrl de,b
  92+ E0E8 63                   ld h,e                          ; H = m
  93+ E0E9 54                   ld d,h                          ; A: the roar's noise period
  94+ E0EA 1E 0D                ld e,ENG_NOISE_MUL
  95+ E0EC ED 30                mul d,e
  96+ E0EE 06 04                ld b,4
  97+ E0F0 ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; m*13/16
  98+ E0F2 3E 1D                ld a,ENG_NOISE0
  99+ E0F4 93                   sub e
 100+ E0F5 5F                   ld e,a
 101+ E0F6 3E 06                ld a,AY_NOISE
 102+ E0F8 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 103+ E0FB 54                   ld d,h                          ; the volumes: louder with speed
 104+ E0FC 1E 07                ld e,ENG_VOL_MUL
 105+ E0FE ED 30                mul d,e
 106+ E100 06 05                ld b,5
 107+ E102 ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 108+ E104 7B                   ld a,e
 109+ E105 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
 110+ E106 C6 04                add a,ENG_ROAR_VOL0
 111+ E108 5F                   ld e,a
 112+ E109 3E 08                ld a,AY_VOL_A
 113+ E10B CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 114+ E10E 7D                   ld a,l
 115+ E10F C6 02                add a,ENG_WHINE_VOL0
 116+ E111 5F                   ld e,a
 117+ E112 3E 09                ld a,AY_VOL_B
 118+ E114 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 119+ E117 7B                   ld a,e
 120+ E118 D6 02                sub ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 121+ E11A 5F                   ld e,a
 122+ E11B 3E 0A                ld a,AY_VOL_C
 123+ E11D                      ; fall through
 124+ E11D
 125+ E11D              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected AY chip (here: the
 126+ E11D              ; interrupt's own, as ay_write is in a page that may not be in).  Keeps D,
 127+ E11D              ; E, HL.
 128+ E11D              isr_ay:
 129+ E11D 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 130+ E120 ED 79                out (c),a
 131+ E122 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 132+ E124 ED 59                out (c),e
 133+ E126 C9                   ret
 134+ E127
 135+ E127              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136+ E127              ; Sound effects, three voices: the weapons on AY 2 (sfx_req), explosions on
 137+ E127              ; AY 3's channels A and B (sfx2_req), and splats on AY 3's channel C
 138+ E127              ; (sfx3_req: a tone only, as the chip's noise is the explosions'), so none
 139+ E127              ; cuts another.  (The splats write only channel C's tone and volume, and
 140+ E127              ; the explosions leave channel C alone, its tone kept on in the mixer.)  The
 141+ E127              ; engines have AY 1.  The game asks for a sound by putting its number in a
 142+ E127              ; voice's request byte (SFX_*, audio.asm): one byte, so safe from any page
 143+ E127              ; at any time; only the interrupt writes the AY chips.  Each voice plays one
 144+ E127              ; sound at a time: a new one cuts the last.  A sound is a list of steps, one
 145+ E127              ; an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value pairs, ended by
 146+ E127              ; SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (the sound is over).
 147+ E127              ; Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
 148+ E127              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 149+ E127              sfx_tick:
 150+ E127 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
 151+ E12A B7                   or a
 152+ E12B C8                   ret z
 153+ E12C 21 8A 3C             ld hl,sfx_req                   ; the weapons, AY 2
 154+ E12F 3E FE                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_2
 155+ E131 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 156+ E134 21 8D 3C             ld hl,sfx2_req                  ; explosions, AY 3 (A, B)
 157+ E137 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 158+ E139 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 159+ E13C 21 90 3C             ld hl,sfx3_req                  ; splats, AY 3 (C)
 160+ E13F 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 161+ E141 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 162+ E144 21 93 3C             ld hl,sfx4_req                  ; the base's warnings, AY 2 (C)
 163+ E147 3E FE                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_2
 164+ E149                      ; fall through
 165+ E149
 166+ E149              ; HL -> a voice (its request byte, then its sound's next step, a word: 0
 167+ E149              ; none), A = its AY chip's select value: start a sound asked for, and play
 168+ E149              ; the next step
 169+ E149              sfx_voice:
 170+ E149 32 96 3C             ld (sv_sel),a
 171+ E14C 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; a new sound asked for?
 172+ E14D B7                   or a
 173+ E14E 28 13                jr z,.play
 174+ E150 36 00                ld (hl),0                       ; (taken)
 175+ E152 E5                   push hl
 176+ E153 21 8C E1             ld hl,sfx_table-2
 177+ E156 87                   add a,a
 178+ E157 ED 31                add hl,a
 179+ E159 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 180+ E15A 23                   inc hl
 181+ E15B 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> it
 182+ E15C E1                   pop hl
 183+ E15D 23                   inc hl
 184+ E15E 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; it starts now (cutting any other)
 185+ E15F 23                   inc hl
 186+ E160 72                   ld (hl),d
 187+ E161 2B                   dec hl
 188+ E162 2B                   dec hl
 189+ E163 23           .play:  inc hl
 190+ E164 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 191+ E165 23                   inc hl
 192+ E166 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> the next step; HL -> its high byte
 193+ E167 7A                   ld a,d
 194+ E168 B3                   or e
 195+ E169 C8                   ret z                           ; nothing playing
 196+ E16A E5                   push hl
 197+ E16B 3A 96 3C             ld a,(sv_sel)
 198+ E16E 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 199+ E171 ED 79                out (c),a
 200+ E173 EB                   ex de,hl
 201+ E174 7E           .lp:    ld a,(hl)                       ; this step's register / value pairs
 202+ E175 23                   inc hl
 203+ E176 FE FE                cp SFX_STEP
 204+ E178 28 0E                jr z,.step
 205+ E17A FE FF                cp SFX_END
 206+ E17C 28 07                jr z,.end
 207+ E17E 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 208+ E17F 23                   inc hl
 209+ E180 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 210+ E183 18 EF                jr .lp
 211+ E185 21 00 00     .end:   ld hl,0                         ; over
 212+ E188 EB           .step:  ex de,hl                        ; (the next step, next interrupt)
 213+ E189 E1                   pop hl
 214+ E18A 72                   ld (hl),d
 215+ E18B 2B                   dec hl
 216+ E18C 73                   ld (hl),e
 217+ E18D C9                   ret
 218+ E18E
# file closed: sound.asm
2756  E18E                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ E18E              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E18E              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (in the audio page, with the players,
   3+ E18E              ; sound.asm: mapped into slot 7 by the interrupt routine while it plays)
   4+ E18E              ;
   5+ E18E              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ E18E              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ E18E              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ E18E              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ E18E              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ E18E              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ E18E              ;==============================================================================
  12+ E18E
  13+ E18E              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ E18E              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ E18E                  ENDM
  20+ E18E
  21+ E18E              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ E18E ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ E18E                  ENDM
  25+ E18E
  26+ E18E              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ E18E              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ E18E              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ E18E              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ E18E              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ E18E ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ E18E ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ E18E ~                    DUP len
  36+ E18E ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ E18E ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ E18E ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ E18E ~                    EDUP
  42+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ E18E                  ENDM
  44+ E18E
  45+ E18E              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ E18E              ; volume v
  47+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ E18E                  ENDM
  50+ E18E

 161+ E2AF              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 162+ E2AF              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 163+ E2AF              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, autocannon 4 x 38 = 152,
 164+ E2AF              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 165+ E2AF              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 166+ E2AF              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the
 167+ E2AF              ; blast the longer it rumbles, 2 steps (40 ms) per level: 600, 480, 240 and
 168+ E2AF              ; 160 ms.
 169+ E2AF              sfx_boom_missile:
 170+ E2AF                      SFX_BOOM 15, 30
 170+ E2AF 07 31       >        db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
 170+ E2B1 02 AF 03 0A >        db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
 170+ E2B5             >BOOM_I  DEFL 0
 170+ E2B5             >        DUP 30
 170+ E2B5 06 10       >        db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(30)
 170+ E2B7 08 0F       >        db AY_VOL_A, ((15)*((30)-BOOM_I)+(30)-1)/(30)
 170+ E2B9 09 0D       >        db AY_VOL_B, (((15)-2)*((30)-BOOM_I)+(30)-1)/(30)
 170+ E2BB FE          >        db SFX_STEP
 170+ E2BC             >BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
 170+ E2BC 06 10       >        db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(30)
 170+ E2BE 08 0F       >        db AY_VOL_A, ((15)*((30)-BOOM_I)+(30)-1)/(30)
 170+ E2C0 09 0D       >        db AY_VOL_B, (((15)-2)*((30)-BOOM_I)+(30)-1)/(30)
 170+ E2C2 FE          >        db SFX_STEP
 170+ E2C3             >BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
 170+ E2C3 06 11       >        db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(30)

 180+ E4E1              ; The VTOL hitting a building (player.asm; on AY 3, as the explosions): a
 181+ E4E1              ; low crunch, like a missile's blast but deeper and shorter.  A cracking
 182+ E4E1              ; hit (brighter noise, full volume) drops at once into the deepest noise

 188+ E4E1              ; The devil charging its lightning (devil.asm), its last DV_HUM_T
 189+ E4E1              ; interrupts (3 s; AY 3 channel C, as the splats, which wait meanwhile:

 240+ E8D9              ; on): a beep, 80 ms, then 40 ms quiet so that hits close together still
 241+ E8D9              ; sound as beeps.  Low (about 440 Hz) for a terrace tile or a barricade
 242+ E8D9              ; hit, mid (about 1.3 kHz) for the landing pad.

 387+ C2F9                      ; crashed - restore and stop, taking |speed| / 4 (a 2-bit shift

 413+ C32C              ; The lateral thrusters (lthrust_fitted): while a strafe control

 443+ C365 DD 21 82 AD          ld ix,cam_z

 455+ C377              ; IX -> 24-bit position (frac, lo, hi). HL = signed delta in 1/256 units.
 456+ C377              ; Clamps the integer part to WORLD_MIN..WORLD_MAX.
 457+ C377              add_pos:
 458+ C377 7C                   ld a,h
 459+ C378 17                   rla
 460+ C379 9F                   sbc a,a
 461+ C37A 4F                   ld c,a                          ; sign extension

 463+ C37E 85                   add a,l
 464+ C37F DD 77 00             ld (ix+0),a
 465+ C382 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 466+ C385 8C                   adc a,h
 467+ C386 DD 77 01             ld (ix+1),a
 468+ C389 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
 469+ C38C 89                   adc a,c
 470+ C38D DD 77 02             ld (ix+2),a
 471+ C390 DD 6E 01             ld l,(ix+1)
 472+ C393 DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)

 476+ C39D B7                   or a
 477+ C39E ED 52                sbc hl,de
 478+ C3A0 38 13                jr c,.lo

 480+ C3A5 DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)

 484+ C3B1 DD 74 02             ld (ix+2),h
 485+ C3B4 C9                   ret
 486+ C3B5 DD 36 01 40  .lo:    ld (ix+1),WORLD_MIN & $FF
 487+ C3B9 DD 36 02 00          ld (ix+2),WORLD_MIN >> 8
 488+ C3BD C9                   ret

 509+ C3CE              ; Returns NZ if the VTOL hits a building: its footprint (10 m x 3 m, turned
 510+ C3CE              ; to the heading; vtol_ground) is over a roof less than COLL_H below it.
 511+ C3CE              check_collision:

 526+ C3E6              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 527+ C3E6              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 528+ C3E6              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 529+ C3E6              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for
 530+ C3E6              ; DEAD_PAUSE frames, then sets game_over (main_loop: the GAME OVER screen,
 531+ C3E6              ; then the main menu).
 532+ C3E6              vtol_wreck:

 536+ C3ED B7                   or a

 548+ C406 FE 08                cp DEAD_FALL_MAX
 549+ C408 38 02                jr c,.vy
 550+ C40A 3E 08                ld a,DEAD_FALL_MAX
 551+ C40C 32 9F AD     .vy:    ld (dead_vy),a
 552+ C40F 21 8E C4             ld hl,dv_frac
 553+ C412 CD 9D A7             call fs_amount
 554+ C415 5F                   ld e,a
 555+ C416 16 00                ld d,0
 556+ C418 2A 85 AD             ld hl,(cam_y)
 557+ C41B B7                   or a
 558+ C41C ED 52                sbc hl,de
 559+ C41E 30 03                jr nc,.y
 560+ C420 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 561+ C423 E5           .y:     push hl
 562+ C424 CD AF A8             call floor_y                    ; HL = the ground under it
 563+ C427 EB                   ex de,hl
 564+ C428 E1                   pop hl
 565+ C429 B7                   or a
 566+ C42A ED 52                sbc hl,de
 567+ C42C 19                   add hl,de
 568+ C42D 30 06                jr nc,.set                      ; still above it
 569+ C42F EB                   ex de,hl                        ; hit the ground: on it
 570+ C430 3E 01                ld a,1
 571+ C432 32 9E AD             ld (dead_down),a
 572+ C435 22 85 AD     .set:   ld (cam_y),hl
 573+ C438 C9                   ret
 574+ C439 3A 20 A8     .down:  ld a,(dt)                       ; on the ground: the pause (ticks),
 575+ C43C 4F                   ld c,a                          ; then GAME OVER
 576+ C43D 3A A0 AD             ld a,(dead_wait)
 577+ C440 91                   sub c
 578+ C441 28 06                jr z,.go
 579+ C443 38 04                jr c,.go
 580+ C445 32 A0 AD             ld (dead_wait),a
 581+ C448 C9                   ret
 582+ C449              .go:
 583+ C449 3E 01                ld a,1
 584+ C44B 32 A3 AD             ld (game_over),a
 585+ C44E C9                   ret
 586+ C44F
 587+ C44F              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 588+ C44F              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 589+ C44F              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 590+ C44F              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 591+ C44F              pitch_damp:
 592+ C44F 2A 89 AD             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 593+ C452 7C                   ld a,h
 594+ C453 B5                   or l
 595+ C454 C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 596+ C455 7C                   ld a,h
 597+ C456 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 598+ C457 CD 41 AD             call abs_hl
 599+ C45A 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 600+ C45B 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 601+ C45D ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 602+ C45F 7A                   ld a,d
 603+ C460 B7                   or a
 604+ C461 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 605+ C463 7B                   ld a,e
 606+ C464 FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 607+ C466 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 608+ C468 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 609+ C46B B7           .sub:   or a
 610+ C46C ED 52                sbc hl,de
 611+ C46E 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 612+ C470 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 613+ C473 F1           .sgn:   pop af
 614+ C474 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 615+ C475 DC 3A AD             call c,neg_hl
 616+ C478 22 89 AD             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 617+ C47B C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  65+ C000
  66+ C000              ; A = the ticks between this weapon's shots: the next due that many on
  67+ C000              ; from when this one was (gun_ovs: past due by up to a frame), so the rate
  68+ C000              ; holds whatever the frames' length; at least a tick away
  69+ C000              gun_rearm:
  70+ C000 21 BC D9             ld hl,gun_ovs
  71+ C003 86                   add a,(hl)
  72+ C004 28 03                jr z,.one
  73+ C006 F2 0B C0             jp p,.s
  74+ C009 3E 01        .one:   ld a,1
  75+ C00B 32 BB D9     .s:     ld (gun_wait),a
  76+ C00E C9                   ret
  77+ C00F

  79+ C00F              ; Per frame: fire, then move every round in flight
  80+ C00F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  81+ C00F              update_weapons:

  83+ C012 CD 63 A7             call fs_mul

  85+ C018 CD 3A AD             call neg_hl
  86+ C01B 22 C0 D9             ld (msl_turn_n),hl
  87+ C01E 3A 23 A8             ld a,(fsteps)                   ; the burst particles: aged and moved
  88+ C021 B7                   or a                            ; a whole frame's worth at a time
  89+ C022 28 08                jr z,.np

  91+ C025 CD 57 D1             call part_update

  93+ C029 3D                   dec a

 370+ C275              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 371+ C275              ; Aim assist, for a centre slot round IX just spawned, pointing where the gun
 372+ C275              ; does (or a linked chain gun's, from its own muzzle: each on its own): the
