 375+ C275              ; AIM_DEV steps of the path, or its box on the path already.  The round turns to its middle, at most
 376+ C275              ; AIM_DEV steps sideways and AIM_DEV up or down: aa_d and aa_ds, kept for the
 377+ C275              ; frame's shots (aim_apply) and the sight.  Only the round: the view doesn't
 378+ C275              ; move.  A chain gun's spread goes on top.
 379+ C275              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 740+ C55F              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the

 742+ C55F              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 743+ C55F              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 744+ C55F              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a

1590+ CB4F 32 09 AE             ld (sight_ry),a

1630+ CBB4              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1631+ CBB4              ; A lich's fireballs, every frame (not with the VTOL a wreck).  A lich with
1632+ CBB4              ; its reload done (LICH_WAIT 0) and the VTOL within FB_RANGE fires at where
1633+ CBB4              ; the VTOL will be: from its velocity (its move last frame, sideways and up
1634+ CBB4              ; or down too) and the flight time at FB_MS, worked out twice over.  The
1635+ CBB4              ; aim is then turned by up to FB_DEV each way (round_spread).  A
1636+ CBB4              ; fireball is a round (BK_FIREBALL, in its own records: the player's guns
1637+ CBB4              ; can't use them up) that passes through monsters and stops at a building,

2241+ CF79              ; beam is traced from the muzzle along the current view direction (the round
2242+ CF79              ; walk, LASER_RANGE long) to the first building, ground or zombie, killing a
2243+ CF79              ; zombie it reaches.  It is kept in laser_rec as a round (state 3) whose
2244+ CF79              ; path runs from the muzzle to where the beam stops; draw_bullets clips it
2245+ CF79              ; to the view, so it rises from the bottom edge of the screen.

2288+ CFCA 21 00 06             ld hl,LASER_RANGE

2290+ CFD0 CD 64 C3             call aim_apply

2292+ CFD6                      ASSERT LASER_DMG == 1

2300+ CFE6
2301+ CFE6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2302+ CFE6              ; The crash, each frame the VTOL is a wreck (vtol_dead; vtol_wreck, player.asm,
2303+ CFE6              ; spins it down): fire bursts WRECK_AHEAD in front of the camera.  The first
2304+ CFE6              ; frame an explosion (WRECK_BOOM, a shake, a bang); falling, WRECK_DEBRIS
2305+ CFE6              ; every other frame; the frame it is down (dead_down) the impact
2306+ CFE6              ; (WRECK_IMPACT, the heavy shake, the crash); then WRECK_EMBERS every 4th
2307+ CFE6              ; frame until GAME OVER.
2308+ CFE6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2309+ CFE6              wreck_fx:
2310+ CFE6 21 84 D0             ld hl,wf_t
2311+ CFE9 7E                   ld a,(hl)
2312+ CFEA 34                   inc (hl)
2313+ CFEB 20 01                jr nz,.n
2314+ CFED 35                   dec (hl)                        ; (at most 255)
2315+ CFEE B7           .n:     or a
2316+ CFEF 20 21                jr nz,.fall
2317+ CFF1 21 06 00             ld hl,WRECK_EYE                 ; destroyed: the explosion, in front
2318+ CFF4 22 86 D0             ld (wf_drop),hl                 ; of the eye
2319+ CFF7 3E 18                ld a,WRECK_BOOM
2320+ CFF9 CD 40 D0             call wf_burst

2322+ CFFF 22 86 D0             ld (wf_drop),hl

2324+ D004 32 8D 3C             ld (sfx2_req),a

2326+ D00A B7                   or a
2327+ D00B C0                   ret nz
2328+ D00C 3E 06                ld a,SHAKE_LEN
2329+ D00E 32 2F A8             ld (shake_t),a
2330+ D011 C9                   ret
2331+ D012 3A 9E AD     .fall:  ld a,(dead_down)
2332+ D015 B7                   or a
2333+ D016 20 0A                jr nz,.down
2334+ D018 3A 84 D0             ld a,(wf_t)                     ; falling: debris
2335+ D01B E6 01                and 1
2336+ D01D C0                   ret nz
2337+ D01E 3E 03                ld a,WRECK_DEBRIS
2338+ D020 18 1E                jr wf_burst
2339+ D022 3A 85 D0     .down:  ld a,(wf_hit)
2340+ D025 B7                   or a
2341+ D026 20 10                jr nz,.burn

2343+ D029 32 85 D0             ld (wf_hit),a
2344+ D02C 3E 0C                ld a,SFX_CRASH                  ; the impact
2345+ D02E 32 8D 3C             ld (sfx2_req),a
2346+ D031 CD F0 A6             call shake_big                  ; (zpolice.asm)
2347+ D034 3E 20                ld a,WRECK_IMPACT
2348+ D036 18 08                jr wf_burst
2349+ D038 3A 84 D0     .burn:  ld a,(wf_t)                     ; on the ground: embers
2350+ D03B E6 03                and 3
2351+ D03D C0                   ret nz

2353+ D040                      ; fall through

2355+ D040              ; A fire particles WRECK_AHEAD in front of the camera, wf_drop below the
2356+ D040              ; eye (but WRECK_LOW above the ground at least)
2357+ D040              wf_burst:

3408+ D914              ; HL = s -> HL = height of the path there, y0 + s * slope, the drop (or

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MAINMENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up, after game over, a load error, and quitting from the
   5+ C000              ; pause (menu_go, zpolice.asm, pages it in).  Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256
   6+ C000              ; (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the large font
   7+ C000              ; (26 x 25 characters), over a picture: ZPDATA/MAINMENU.ZPI, read from the
   8+ C000              ; SD card as the menu opens (l320_image; tools/screen_editor.py edits it),
   9+ C000              ; drawn first as the background, the text printed over it with no paper.  Every frame it
  10+ C000              ; advances the random number generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start
  11+ C000              ; from the same seed each time (the wait for a key press varies), then reads
  12+ C000              ; the keys:
  13+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
  14+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  15+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  16+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  17+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  18+ C000              ; The game start puts the game's Layer 2 back (l2_game_mode).
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              MM_COL          equ 2               ; the options' column
  22+ C000              MM_NOSAVE_ROW   equ 18
  23+ C000
  24+ C000              main_menu:
  25+ C000 CD D6 A0             call screen320                  ; (text.asm) the input page in slot 7
  26+ C003 21 A6 C0             ld hl,mm_img                    ; the background picture (none
  27+ C006 CD 86 45             call l320_image                 ; without the file: the plain screen)
  28+ C009 3E E3                ld a,L320_NOPAPER               ; the text over it
  29+ C00B 32 AE 58             ld (l320_paper),a
  30+ C00E 21 4E C0             ld hl,mm_text                   ; title and options
  31+ C011 CD DC 41             call l320_print_list
  32+ C014 CD 43 A1     .loop:  call menu_frame                 ; one video frame
  33+ C017 CD A2 27             call zrand                      ; stir the random number generator
  34+ C01A CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
  35+ C01D 21 01 03             ld hl,KB_1
  36+ C020 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  37+ C023 C2 0B A4             jp nz,newGame
  38+ C026 21 02 04             ld hl,KB_9                      ; redefine keys
  39+ C029 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  40+ C02C C2 04 A9             jp nz,keydef_go                 ; (zpolice.asm)
  41+ C02F 21 02 03             ld hl,KB_2                      ; continue the save game
  42+ C032 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  43+ C035 28 DD                jr z,.loop
  44+ C037 CD 6F AA             call load_save                  ; (zpolice.asm; pages the file
  45+ C03A D2 AB AA             jp nc,continue_game             ; handler in)
  46+ C03D ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; none (or not usable): say so
  47+ C041 11 06 12             ld de,MM_NOSAVE_ROW<<8 | (F12_COLS-13)/2
  48+ C044 0E E0                ld c,SCR_BAD
  49+ C046 21 98 C0             ld hl,txt_no_save
  50+ C049 CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  51+ C04C 18 C6                jr .loop
  52+ C04E
  53+ C04E              ; row, column, colour, text, 0 ... $FF

   8+ C000              ; CONTINUE and the load-out screen (loadout_go).  After the last level, the
   9+ C000              ; game complete screen instead (game_done_go: menu.asm).  Drawn on Layer 2
  10+ C000              ; at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the
  11+ C000              ; large font (26 x 25 characters), with the input page in slot 7.
  12+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  13+ C000
  14+ C000              LE_TITLE_ROW    equ 2
  15+ C000              LE_SAVED_ROW    equ 5               ; HUMANS SAVED n
  16+ C000              LE_SALV_ROW     equ 6               ; SALVAGE n
  17+ C000              LE_REARM_ROW    equ 8               ; AMMUNITION REPLENISHED
  18+ C000              LE_COL          equ 1               ; the lines' column (NIGHT VISION -
  19+ C000                                                  ; MONOCHROME is 25 long)
  20+ C000              LE_NUM_COL      equ 17              ; the numbers'
  21+ C000              LE_PROMPT_ROW   equ 23              ; PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE
  22+ C000
  23+ C000              ; The level's last wave is wiped out: LEVEL n COMPLETE, until SPACE is
  24+ C000              ; pressed, then the load-out screen and the next level (next_level,
  25+ C000              ; zpolice.asm)
  26+ C000              level_complete_screen:
  27+ C000 31 B8 B5             ld sp,stack_top
  28+ C003 3A 99 AD             ld a,(level)                    ; the last level: the whole game
  29+ C006 FE 32                cp LEVEL_LAST
  30+ C008 D2 FD A8             jp nc,game_done_go              ; (zpolice.asm: menu.asm's page)
  31+ C00B CD D6 A0             call screen320                  ; (text.asm) the input page in slot 7
  32+ C00E 3A 99 AD             ld a,(level)                    ; LEVEL n COMPLETE: its digits (a
  33+ C011 06 2F                ld b,'0'-1                      ; level below LEVEL_LAST: 1 or 2)
  34+ C013 04           .tens:  inc b
  35+ C014 D6 0A                sub 10
  36+ C016 30 FB                jr nc,.tens
  37+ C018 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  38+ C01A 4F                   ld c,a
  39+ C01B 21 58 C0             ld hl,txt_ld_num
  40+ C01E 1E 05                ld e,(F12_COLS-16)/2            ; (centred)
  41+ C020 78                   ld a,b
  42+ C021 FE 30                cp '0'
  43+ C023 28 03                jr z,.units
  44+ C025 77                   ld (hl),a
  45+ C026 23                   inc hl
  46+ C027 1D                   dec e
  47+ C028 71           .units: ld (hl),c
  48+ C029 23                   inc hl
  49+ C02A D5                   push de
  50+ C02B EB                   ex de,hl
  51+ C02C 21 64 C0             ld hl,txt_ld_end
  52+ C02F 01 0A 00             ld bc,TXT_LD_END
  53+ C032 ED B0                ldir
  54+ C034 D1                   pop de
  55+ C035 16 02                ld d,LE_TITLE_ROW
  56+ C037 0E FC                ld c,SCR_TITLE
  57+ C039 21 52 C0             ld hl,txt_level_done
  58+ C03C CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  59+ C03F CD 6E C0             call rearm_all                  ; every weapon's ammo full again
  60+ C042 CD F4 32             call hum_unload_all             ; (human.asm) those aboard: rescued
  61+ C045 CD 90 C0             call salvage_award              ; the humans saved: salvage, unlocks
  62+ C048 CD F5 C3             call le_space
  63+ C04B 21 99 AD             ld hl,level
  64+ C04E 34                   inc (hl)
  65+ C04F C3 F6 A8             jp loadout_go                   ; (zpolice.asm) the load-out screen,
  66+ C052                                                      ; then the next level
  67+ C052
  68+ C052              txt_level_done:
  69+ C052 4C 45 56 45          db "LEVEL "
  69+ C056 4C 20
  70+ C058              txt_ld_num:
  71+ C058 00 00 00...          ds 2+TXT_LD_END                 ; (filled in)
  72+ C064              txt_ld_end:
  73+ C064 20 43 4F 4D          db " COMPLETE", 0
  73+ C068 50 4C 45 54
  73+ C06C 45 00
  74+ C06E              TXT_LD_END      equ $-txt_ld_end
  75+ C06E
  76+ C06E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  77+ C06E              ; End of a level: every slot's weapon gets its full load again (wpn_cfg,
  78+ C06E              ; WCFG_LOAD; AMMO_INF for the guns, 0 for an empty slot), and the screen
  79+ C06E              ; says so
  80+ C06E              rearm_all:
  81+ C06E DD 21 8C AD          ld ix,wpn_slots
  82+ C072 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
  83+ C074 DD 7E 00     .lp:    ld a,(ix+WPN_TYPE)
  84+ C077 CD DF A8             call wpn_cfg_ptr                ; (resident; preserves BC)
  85+ C07A 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; WCFG_LOAD
  86+ C07B DD 77 01             ld (ix+WPN_AMMO),a
  87+ C07E DD 23                inc ix
  88+ C080 DD 23                inc ix
  89+ C082 10 F0                djnz .lp
  90+ C084 16 08                ld d,LE_REARM_ROW
  91+ C086 1E 01                ld e,LE_COL
  92+ C088 0E FF                ld c,SCR_TEXT
  93+ C08A 21 DE C3             ld hl,txt_sa_rearm
  94+ C08D C3 D0 41             jp l320_print_at
  95+ C090                      ASSERT WCFG_LOAD == 0
  96+ C090
  97+ C090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  98+ C090              ; Salvage, at the end of a level: each human saved this level (saved) adds
  99+ C090              ; a salvage point (salvage_points).  Every point total in salvage_tab that
 100+ C090              ; the new total reaches (passed over from the old one) gives its rewards: a
 101+ C090              ; weapon unlocked (one more of that type in wpn_stock, for the load-out page)
 102+ C090              ; and / or (SA_* flags) a full repair (vtol_hp = VTOL_HP) or the booster
 103+ C090              ; module (fitted at once, its tank full).  After the table's last total,
 104+ C090              ; SALVAGE_TAIL, every SALVAGE_STEP more points is a full repair.  Shown on
 105+ C090              ; the LEVEL COMPLETE screen: the humans saved, the salvage, and a line for
 106+ C090              ; each reward (rows SA_ROW0..SA_ROW_MAX; any more aren't shown).
 107+ C090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 108+ C090              SA_REPAIR       equ 1               ; salvage_tab rewards (flags): full repair,
 109+ C090              SA_BOOSTER      equ 2               ;   the booster module,
 110+ C090              SA_NV_GREEN     equ 4               ;   vision modes (vision_owned): night
 111+ C090              SA_NV_MONO      equ 8               ;   vision green, monochrome,
 112+ C090              SA_THERMAL      equ 16              ;   thermal, the vertical thrusters
 113+ C090              SA_VTHRUST      equ 32              ;   (vthrust_fitted), the lateral
 114+ C090              SA_LTHRUST      equ 64              ;   thrusters (lthrust_fitted)
 115+ C090              SALVAGE_TAIL    equ 145
 116+ C090              SALVAGE_STEP    equ 5
 117+ C090              SA_ROW0         equ 10
 118+ C090              SA_ROW_MAX      equ 21
 119+ C090              salvage_award:
 120+ C090 16 05                ld d,LE_SAVED_ROW               ; HUMANS SAVED n
 121+ C092 1E 01                ld e,LE_COL

 124+ C099 CD D0 41             call l320_print_at

 131+ C0AB 22 3E C2             ld (sa_old),hl
 132+ C0AE 3A AA 36             ld a,(saved)
 133+ C0B1 ED 31                add hl,a
 134+ C0B3 22 A4 AD             ld (salvage_points),hl
 135+ C0B6 16 06                ld d,LE_SALV_ROW                ; SALVAGE n

 143+ C0CB 3E 0A                ld a,SA_ROW0
 144+ C0CD 32 40 C2             ld (sa_row),a
 145+ C0D0 21 41 C2             ld hl,salvage_tab
 146+ C0D3 5E           .lp:    ld e,(hl)                       ; DE = its points total
 147+ C0D4 23                   inc hl
 148+ C0D5 56                   ld d,(hl)

 150+ C0D7 7A                   ld a,d
 151+ C0D8 A3                   and e
 152+ C0D9 3C                   inc a
 153+ C0DA 28 0F                jr z,.tail                      ; ($FFFF: the end)
 154+ C0DC 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; B = weapon, C = SA_* rewards
 155+ C0DD 47                   ld b,a
 156+ C0DE 23                   inc hl
 157+ C0DF 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 158+ C0E0 23                   inc hl
 159+ C0E1 E5                   push hl
 160+ C0E2 CD 08 C1             call sa_reached
 161+ C0E5 DC 1A C1             call c,sa_reward
 162+ C0E8 E1                   pop hl
 163+ C0E9 18 E8                jr .lp
 164+ C0EB 11 91 00     .tail:  ld de,SALVAGE_TAIL              ; then a repair every SALVAGE_STEP
 165+ C0EE 21 05 00     .tl:    ld hl,SALVAGE_STEP

 167+ C0F2 EB                   ex de,hl
 168+ C0F3 2A A4 AD             ld hl,(salvage_points)
 169+ C0F6 B7                   or a
 170+ C0F7 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 171+ C0F9 D8                   ret c                           ; beyond the new total
 172+ C0FA 06 00                ld b,WPN_NONE
 173+ C0FC 0E 01                ld c,SA_REPAIR
 174+ C0FE D5                   push de
 175+ C0FF CD 08 C1             call sa_reached
 176+ C102 DC 1A C1             call c,sa_reward
 177+ C105 D1                   pop de
 178+ C106 18 E6                jr .tl
 179+ C108
 180+ C108              ; Carry set if total DE is reached this time: sa_old < DE <= salvage_points.
 181+ C108              ; Preserves BC, DE.
 182+ C108              sa_reached:
 183+ C108 2A 3E C2             ld hl,(sa_old)
 184+ C10B B7                   or a
 185+ C10C ED 52                sbc hl,de
 186+ C10E 38 02                jr c,.lo
 187+ C110 B7                   or a                            ; old >= DE: reached before
 188+ C111 C9                   ret
 189+ C112 2A A4 AD     .lo:    ld hl,(salvage_points)
 190+ C115 B7                   or a
 191+ C116 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; new - DE: no carry if reached
 192+ C118 3F                   ccf
 193+ C119 C9                   ret

 195+ C11A              ; Reward: B = weapon type (WPN_NONE: none) unlocked, C = SA_* flags: a full

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level loading (8K page PAGE_LEVEL, game logic: runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6; it pages the file handler, PAGE_FILE, into slot 7)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Each level is a file, ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL, naming its city, ZPDATA/CITYnn.ZPC
   6+ C000              ; (both made by gentables.py; the formats are described there).  A city is
   7+ C000              ; played for several levels.  load_level reads both:
   8+ C000              ;   * the level record into level_cur (levels.asm): city name, zombie and
   9+ C000              ;     wave counts, the draw distance, ...;
  10+ C000              ;   * the city into the city bank (page 7, slot 3): city_col at $6000 and
  11+ C000              ;     city_map at $7000, one 8K read;
  12+ C000              ;   * the level's own map changes (x, z, cell code, city_col), for hand-made
  13+ C000              ;     layouts;
  14+ C000              ;   * the city's palette and sky colour into the Layer 2 palette, then the
  15+ C000              ;     level's own palette over it, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP);
  16+ C000              ;   * view_r / dot_r from the draw distance (2..VIEW_R tiles).
  17+ C000              ; Loading the map also clears every cell's zombie and human marks.  The
  18+ C000              ; files must be in the ZPDATA folder beside zpolice.nex on the SD card.
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              ; Level file
  22+ C000              LVF_CITY        equ 5               ; city number
  23+ C000              LVF_REC         equ 6               ; the level record (LV_SIZE bytes)
  24+ C000              LVF_NCHG        equ LVF_REC+LV_SIZE ; number of map changes,
  25+ C000              LVF_CHG         equ LVF_NCHG+1      ; then x, z, cell code, city_col each
  26+ C000              LVF_CHG_MAX     equ 64
  27+ C000              LVF_MAX         equ LVF_CHG+4*LVF_CHG_MAX
  28+ C000              ; City file
  29+ C000              CTF_SKY         equ 14              ; sky colour: RRRGGGBB, low blue bit
  30+ C000              CTF_PAL         equ 32              ; the palette, 256 pairs
  31+ C000              CTF_DATA        equ CTF_PAL+512     ; then city_col, city_map
  32+ C000              ; Level palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP, optional: tools/levelpal.py)
  33+ C000              LPF_PAL         equ 8               ; the palette, 256 pairs
  34+ C000              LPF_SIZE        equ LPF_PAL+512
  35+ C000              LEVEL_VERSION   equ 2               ; the files' format versions (+4): the
  36+ C000              CITY_VERSION    equ 1               ;   level file's 2 (specials by wave)
  37+ C000              LPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  38+ C000              ; Vision palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPV: tools/visionpal.py)
  39+ C000              VPF_PAL         equ 8               ; 4 palettes (VM_MODES), 256 pairs each
  40+ C000              VPF_SIZE        equ VPF_PAL+4*512
  41+ C000              VPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  42+ C000              LDERR_BADFILE   equ 255             ; error code: not a valid file
  43+ C000
  44+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  45+ C000              ; A = level (1..99): load it.  Carry set on failure, A = the esxDOS error
  46+ C000              ; code or LDERR_BADFILE.  Leaves PAGE_FILE in slot 7.
  47+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ C000              load_level:

   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - load-out screen (8K page PAGE_LOADOUT, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Before the first level (newGame) and between levels, after LEVEL COMPLETE
   5+ C000              ; (loadout_go pages it in).  On the
   6+ C000              ; left, the store: every weapon type unlocked (wpn_unlocked) with the number
   7+ C000              ; in store (wpn_stock), even 0 when the only one is fitted.  On the right,
   8+ C000              ; the VTOL's 5 weapon slots: a picture of the VTOL (ZPDATA/VTOL.ZPI, read
   9+ C000              ; from the SD card as the screen opens: l320_image) drawn first, as the
  10+ C000              ; background, with a box and the number at each slot's hardpoint (lo_hp),
  11+ C000              ; and the list of what is fitted in each.  The text is printed over the
  12+ C000              ; picture (no paper); a field that changes gets its piece of the background
  13+ C000              ; back first (l320_bg_save, l320_restore).
  14+ C000              ;   1-5    select a slot (yellow)
  15+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the store list.  The highlighted
  16+ C000              ;          weapon is green if it can be fitted in the selected slot (the
  17+ C000              ;          slot allows it, wpn_fits, and one is in store), red if not; the
  18+ C000              ;          rest of the list is white.
  19+ C000              ;   SPACE  fit the highlighted weapon in the selected slot, if it can be:
  20+ C000              ;          one comes out of the store, with a full load (WCFG_LOAD), and
  21+ C000              ;          whatever was fitted there goes back into the store
  22+ C000              ;   U      unload the selected slot: its weapon back into the store, the
  23+ C000              ;          slot EMPTY (lo_unload)
  24+ C000              ;   0      done: start the level (next_level), only with a weapon in slot 1
  25+ C000              ;          (the centre slot); while it is empty 0: START LEVEL is red

 200+ C116              ; U: unload the selected slot: its weapon back into the store (its ammo
 201+ C116              ; with it: refitted, it gets a full load), the slot EMPTY.  If it was the
 202+ C116              ; slot the game fires (wpn_sel), the first slot still fitted is chosen.

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - redefine keys screen (8K page PAGE_KEYDEF, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; From the main menu (option 9, keydef_go pages it in).  Lists every control
   6+ C000              ; (K_ACTIONS of them) with its key (key_defs) and its joystick input
   7+ C000              ; (joy_defs, "-" for none; input.asm).
   8+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the list (white; highlighted green);
   9+ C000              ;          KD_VIS rows of it show, scrolling to keep the highlight in view
  10+ C000              ;   SPACE  "PRESS A KEY OR JOYSTICK", a second's pause, then the next input
  11+ C000              ;          becomes the highlighted control's key, or its joystick input if
  12+ C000              ;          it is a joystick's, unless another control already uses it: then
  13+ C000              ;          "KEY ALREADY IN USE" (for a second) and no change
  14+ C000              ;   0      every key and joystick input back to its default (key_defaults,
  15+ C000              ;          joy_defaults)
  16+ C000              ;   1      back to the main menu (menu_go), saving the definitions first if
  17+ C000              ;          they changed (kd_save; "KEYS NOT SAVED" for a second if they
  18+ C000              ;          couldn't be)
  19+ C000              ; These keys are fixed (key_code_pressed), whatever the controls are set to.
  20+ C000              ; Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in
  21+ C000              ; slot 2), with the input page in slot 7: the title, messages and help in
  22+ C000              ; the large font (26 x 25 grid), the headings and the list in the 8x8 one
  23+ C000              ; (40 x 32 grid: they need the columns).
  24+ C000              ;
  25+ C000              ; The definitions are kept on the SD card as ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK (beside the level
  26+ C000              ; files): "ZPKY", KF_VERSION, K_ACTIONS, then key_defs and joy_defs (2 bytes
  27+ C000              ; each control).  start loads them (kd_load, with this page in slot 6), if the
  28+ C000              ; file is there and fits this game: else the defaults.

# file opened: specials.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - special monsters (8K page PAGE_SPECIAL, game logic: runs at
   3+ C000              ; $C000 in slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Special monsters use the zombie records after the zombies' own (NZOMB ..
   6+ C000              ; NMON-1, zombie.asm), so they share the zombies' drawing (zombie_cell,
   7+ C000              ; fig_draw), map blips, cell marks (zflags), weapon hits and zdamage.  The
   8+ C000              ; record's type (+15) says which monster it is.  Each wave's specials come
   9+ C000              ; from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: up to LV_SPEC_SLOTS types,
  10+ C000              ; SPEC_*, and how many of each), placed by spec_wave as the wave starts;
  11+ C000              ; the level's start is wave 1 (spec_init).  spec_update moves them each
  12+ C000              ; frame, after zombie_update.
  13+ C000              ;
  14+ C000              ; The ghost (ZT_GHOST, special monster id SPEC_GHOST): a stick man under a white
  15+ C000              ; sheet.  It can't attack the base.  It flies at twice the zombies' speed,
  16+ C000              ; at any angle, and up and down between the ground and the VTOL's ceiling
  17+ C000              ; (MAX_Y), over buildings lower than it.
  18+ C000              ;   * Roaming: it flies in a random direction (a random climb or descent
  19+ C000              ;     too) until something makes it turn: a building in the way or the map
  20+ C000              ;     edge (a new random direction at once), or, at its decision check
  21+ C000              ;     every GHOST_DECIDE (30) frames, a human or the VTOL within GHOST_SEE
  22+ C000              ;     (3 tiles) that it can see.
  23+ C000              ;   * Chasing: it flies straight at the nearest one it can see, aiming
  24+ C000              ;     again every GHOST_TRACK (5) frames.  If it loses sight of its target
  25+ C000              ;     (behind a taller building) or the target is gone, it roams again in a
  26+ C000              ;     random direction, back on the 30-frame cycle.
  27+ C000              ;   * Attacking: within ATTACK_R (0.1 tile) of its target on each axis it
  28+ C000              ;     stops and takes GHOST_DMG hit point every GHOST_HIT_FRAMES (10)
  29+ C000              ;     frames: from a human (HUMAN_HP) until it dies, or from the VTOL
  30+ C000              ;     (vtol_hp, VTOL_HP; at 0 it is destroyed and the game ends).  Its map blip is red
  31+ C000              ;     meanwhile (zatk_flags, zblip_red), as an attacking zombie's.  If the
  32+ C000              ;     target moves out of reach it chases it again; once the human is dead
  33+ C000              ;     it roams again.
  34+ C000              ;   * It has GHOST_HP (10) hit points; any weapon can shoot it.  Killed, it
  35+ C000              ;     fades out where it is, white to near black in 4 steps of 3 frames
  36+ C000              ;     (GM_DYING; zdamage starts it, zombie_draw colours it, g_dying ends
  37+ C000              ;     it), and can't be hit meanwhile.
  38+ C000              ; Ghost record fields, besides the zombies' (zombie.asm):
  39+ C000              ;   +11 frames to its next decision check, +16 mode (GM_*), +17 frames to
  40+ C000              ;   its next blow, +18 hit points, +21,+22 height of its feet, +23,+24 and
  41+ C000              ;   +25,+26 velocity x, z (signed 8.8 units a frame), +27,+28 the x and z
  42+ C000              ;   position fractions, +29 climb (signed units a frame), +30 target
  43+ C000              ;   (TG_NONE, TG_VTOL, or a human's index).
  44+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ C000
  46+ C000              GHOST_HP        equ 10              ; hit points
  47+ C000              GHOST_DECIDE    equ 30              ; frames between decisions while roaming
  48+ C000              GHOST_TRACK     equ 5               ; and while chasing
  49+ C000              GHOST_SEE       equ 3*TILE_UNITS    ; it spots humans / the VTOL this near
  50+ C000              GHOST_HIT_FRAMES equ 10             ; frames between blows
  51+ C000              GHOST_DMG       equ 1               ; hit points a blow
  52+ C000              GHOST_CLIMB     equ 1               ; units a frame up or down
  53+ C000              GHOST_AIM_MIN   equ 80              ; (aiming: nearer counts as this far)
  54+ C000              GM_ROAM         equ 0               ; modes (+16)
  55+ C000              GM_CHASE        equ 1
  56+ C000              GM_ATTACK       equ 2
  57+ C000              GM_DYING        equ 3               ; killed: fading out (+17 frames left)
  58+ C000              GHOST_FADE_FRAMES equ 12            ; the fade: 4 steps of 3 frames
  59+ C000              TG_NONE         equ $FF             ; targets (+30)
  60+ C000              TG_VTOL         equ $FE
  61+ C000              TG_BASE         equ $C0             ; + a base tile's index (base_hp, 0..24)
  62+ C000              ; The banshee (ZT_BANSHEE, id SPEC_BANSHEE): a ghost that flies twice as
  63+ C000              ; fast, reaches BANSHEE_R (0.5 tile), does BANSHEE_DMG a blow and also
  64+ C000              ; attacks the base (the terrace and pad tiles).
  65+ C000              ; The ghoul (ZT_GHOUL, id SPEC_GHOUL, zombie.asm): a half-height zombie
  66+ C000              ; walking at five times the zombies' speed.  It is placed here (spec_wave)
  67+ C000              ; but moved, drawn and hit as a zombie.
  68+ C000              ; The lich (ZT_LICH, id SPEC_LICH): a city's boss, in the last wave of its
  69+ C000              ; last level (the level files).  Placed here (lich_init); walks as a zombie
  70+ C000              ; at 4 times the speed, drawn at LICH_H; shoots fireballs at the VTOL
  71+ C000              ; (lich_update, weapons.asm).  Each city's is harder: LICH_HP + LICH_HP_STEP
  72+ C000              ; hit points a city before it, and a shot every LICH_RATE frames,
  73+ C000              ; LICH_RATE_STEP fewer a city before it, at least LICH_RATE_MIN.  Its
  74+ C000              ; record: +18 and +23 (LICH_HP_HI) its hit points, 16 bits; +24 (LICH_WAIT)
  75+ C000              ; frames to its next shot; +25 (LICH_FRAMES) frames between.
  76+ C000              ; The devil (ZT_DEVIL, id SPEC_DEVIL): the final boss (devil.asm).
  77+ C000              ; (Which waves have which is the level files' business: gentables.py.)
  78+ C000              BANSHEE_HP      equ 8
  79+ C000              BANSHEE_DMG     equ 5
  80+ C000              BANSHEE_R       equ TILE_UNITS/2
  81+ C000              BASE_TILES      equ (2*TERRACE_R+1)*(2*TERRACE_R+1)
  82+ C000              LICH_HP         equ 25              ; the first city's
  83+ C000              LICH_HP_STEP    equ 5               ; more a city
  84+ C000              LICH_RATE       equ 150             ; the first city's frames between shots
  85+ C000              LICH_RATE_STEP  equ 5               ; fewer a city
  86+ C000              LICH_RATE_MIN   equ 10
  87+ C000
  88+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ C000              ; A level's start: every special record inactive, then wave 1's specials
  90+ C000              ; (the level's start is wave 1, as any other: spec_wave)
  91+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  92+ C000              spec_init:
  93+ C000 DD 21 06 30          ld ix,zombies+NZOMB*ZREC
  94+ C004 06 08                ld b,NSPEC
  95+ C006 0E 28                ld c,NZOMB                      ; record index
  96+ C008 79           .lp:    ld a,c
  97+ C009 21 50 2A             ld hl,zatk_flags                ; not attacking
  98+ C00C ED 31                add hl,a
  99+ C00E 36 00                ld (hl),FALSE
 100+ C010 DD 36 0A 00          ld (ix+10),0                    ; inactive,
 101+ C014 DD 36 0E 00          ld (ix+14),0                    ; no blip,
 102+ C018 DD 36 13 FF          ld (ix+19),$FF                  ; no cell marked
 103+ C01C 11 22 00             ld de,ZREC
 104+ C01F DD 19                add ix,de
 105+ C021 0C                   inc c
 106+ C022 10 E4                djnz .lp
 107+ C024 CD D3 C7             call dv_reset                   ; (devil.asm) nothing coming down
 108+ C027 CD 2E C1             call spec_wave                  ; wave 1's specials (wave_number 1)
 109+ C02A C3 56 22             jp zflags                       ; (zombie.asm) mark their cells
 110+ C02D
 111+ C02D              ; Special monster IX (record sp_idx) of type sp_type: at a random street
 112+ C02D              ; position and height, roaming in a random direction
 113+ C02D              ghost_init:
 114+ C02D 3A A4 C7             ld a,(sp_type)
 115+ C030 DD 77 0F             ld (ix+15),a
 116+ C033 CD 20 C2             call g_params                   ; (its speed for its first direction)
 117+ C036 CD A2 27     .try:   call zrand                      ; (zombie page)
 118+ C039 7D                   ld a,l
 119+ C03A E6 3F                and GRID-1
 120+ C03C DD 77 01             ld (ix+1),a                     ; x cell
 121+ C03F 7C                   ld a,h
 122+ C040 E6 3F                and GRID-1
 123+ C042 DD 77 03             ld (ix+3),a                     ; z cell

 126+ C049 E6 1F                and CELL_CODE

 128+ C04D CD A2 27             call zrand
 129+ C050 7D                   ld a,l
 130+ C051 E6 7F                and 127
 131+ C053 C6 40                add a,64                        ; 64..191 inside the cell
 132+ C055 DD 77 00             ld (ix+0),a
 133+ C058 7C                   ld a,h
 134+ C059 E6 7F                and 127
 135+ C05B C6 40                add a,64
 136+ C05D DD 77 02             ld (ix+2),a
 137+ C060 CD A2 27             call zrand
 138+ C063 7D                   ld a,l
 139+ C064 E6 7F                and 127                         ; height 0..127 (under MAX_Y)
 140+ C066 DD 77 15             ld (ix+21),a
 141+ C069 DD 36 16 00          ld (ix+22),0
 142+ C06D AF                   xor a
 143+ C06E DD 77 1B             ld (ix+27),a                    ; position fractions
 144+ C071 DD 77 1C             ld (ix+28),a
 145+ C074 DD 77 05             ld (ix+5),a
 146+ C077 DD 77 07             ld (ix+7),a
 147+ C07A DD 36 10 00          ld (ix+16),GM_ROAM
 148+ C07E DD 36 12 0A          ld (ix+18),GHOST_HP
 149+ C082 DD 7E 0F             ld a,(ix+15)
 150+ C085 FE 05                cp ZT_BANSHEE
 151+ C087 20 04                jr nz,.hp
 152+ C089 DD 36 12 08          ld (ix+18),BANSHEE_HP
 153+ C08D              .hp:
 154+ C08D DD 36 1E FF          ld (ix+30),TG_NONE
 155+ C091 DD 36 0A 01          ld (ix+10),1                    ; active
 156+ C095 3A A5 C7             ld a,(sp_idx)                   ; first decisions spread over the
 157+ C098 5F                   ld e,a                          ; 30 frames
 158+ C099 16 07                ld d,7
 159+ C09B ED 30                mul d,e
 160+ C09D 7B                   ld a,e
 161+ C09E D6 1E        .mod:   sub GHOST_DECIDE
 162+ C0A0 30 FC                jr nc,.mod
 163+ C0A2 C6 1F                add a,GHOST_DECIDE+1
 164+ C0A4 DD 77 0B             ld (ix+11),a
 165+ C0A7 CD 88 C2             call g_random
 166+ C0AA C3 AB 38             jp zblip                        ; (map.asm)
 167+ C0AD
 168+ C0AD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 169+ C0AD              ; Per frame (after zombie_update): move every special monster, then mark
 170+ C0AD              ; the cells again
 171+ C0AD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 172+ C0AD              spec_update:
 173+ C0AD CD 62 C8             call dv_frame                   ; (devil.asm) the bolt, buildings falling
 174+ C0B0 3A 19 31             ld a,(zwave_new)                ; a new wave: its banshees or ghouls
 175+ C0B3 B7                   or a
 176+ C0B4 C4 2E C1             call nz,spec_wave
 177+ C0B7 DD 21 06 30          ld ix,zombies+NZOMB*ZREC
 178+ C0BB 06 08                ld b,NSPEC
 179+ C0BD 0E 28                ld c,NZOMB
 180+ C0BF C5           .lp:    push bc
 181+ C0C0 79                   ld a,c
 182+ C0C1 32 A5 C7             ld (sp_idx),a
 183+ C0C4 DD CB 0A 46          bit 0,(ix+10)
 184+ C0C8 28 27                jr z,.nx                        ; gone
 185+ C0CA DD 7E 0F             ld a,(ix+15)

 187+ C0CF 38 20                jr c,.nx                        ; (a ghoul walks: zombie_update)
 188+ C0D1 FE 06                cp ZT_DEVIL
 189+ C0D3 20 05                jr nz,.gh
 190+ C0D5 CD E3 C8             call devil_move                 ; (devil.asm)
 191+ C0D8 18 17                jr .nx
 192+ C0DA CD 20 C2     .gh:    call g_params                   ; a ghost or banshee: its settings
 193+ C0DD 3A 23 A8             ld a,(fsteps)                   ; and a frame's worth at a time:
 194+ C0E0 B7                   or a                            ; deciding, flying, blows, fading
 195+ C0E1 28 0E                jr z,.nx
 196+ C0E3 F5           .gm:    push af
 197+ C0E4 CD FD C0             call ghost_move
 198+ C0E7 F1                   pop af
 199+ C0E8 DD CB 0A 46          bit 0,(ix+10)
 200+ C0EC 28 03                jr z,.nx                        ; (gone)
 201+ C0EE 3D                   dec a
 202+ C0EF 20 F2                jr nz,.gm
 203+ C0F1 11 22 00     .nx:    ld de,ZREC
 204+ C0F4 DD 19                add ix,de
 205+ C0F6 C1                   pop bc
 206+ C0F7 0C                   inc c
 207+ C0F8 10 C5                djnz .lp
 208+ C0FA C3 56 22             jp zflags                       ; their cells, as they are now
 209+ C0FD
 210+ C0FD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 211+ C0FD              ; Ghost IX, one frame
 212+ C0FD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 213+ C0FD              ghost_move:
 214+ C0FD DD 7E 10             ld a,(ix+16)
 215+ C100 FE 03                cp GM_DYING
 216+ C102 CA 5A C2             jp z,g_dying
 217+ C105 FE 02                cp GM_ATTACK
 218+ C107 CA CC C3             jp z,g_attack
 219+ C10A DD 35 0B             dec (ix+11)                     ; decision check due?

 224+ C118 CC A9 C3             call z,g_reach                  ; close enough to attack?
 225+ C11B DD 7E 10             ld a,(ix+16)
 226+ C11E FE 02                cp GM_ATTACK
 227+ C120 C8                   ret z                           ; (its blip is red)
 228+ C121 3A 18 31             ld a,(zanim)                    ; its map blip, every 8 frames
 229+ C124 21 A5 C7             ld hl,sp_idx
 230+ C127 86                   add a,(hl)
 231+ C128 E6 07                and 7
 232+ C12A C0                   ret nz
 233+ C12B C3 AB 38             jp zblip
 234+ C12E
 235+ C12E              ; A new wave began (zwave_new, zombie.asm; spec_init for wave 1): its
 236+ C12E              ; specials from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: wave_number's
 237+ C12E              ; record), each of its LV_SPEC_SLOTS types (SPEC_NONE: none) as many as it
 238+ C12E              ; says, into free special records.  Waves past LV_MAX_WAVES have none.
 239+ C12E              spec_wave:
 240+ C12E AF                   xor a
 241+ C12F 32 19 31             ld (zwave_new),a
 242+ C132 3A A2 AD             ld a,(wave_number)
 243+ C135 3D                   dec a
 244+ C136 FE 0A                cp LV_MAX_WAVES
 245+ C138 D0                   ret nc
 246+ C139 5F                   ld e,a
 247+ C13A 16 0A                ld d,LV_WAVE_REC
 248+ C13C ED 30                mul d,e
 249+ C13E 21 72 A0             ld hl,level_cur+LV_WAVE_DATA
 250+ C141 19                   add hl,de
 251+ C142 22 A7 C7             ld (sw_ptr),hl                  ; -> this wave's types
 252+ C145 06 05                ld b,LV_SPEC_SLOTS
 253+ C147 C5           .sl:    push bc
 254+ C148 2A A7 C7             ld hl,(sw_ptr)
 255+ C14B 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; a type
 256+ C14C FE 05                cp SPEC_IDS
 257+ C14E 30 14                jr nc,.ns                       ; (SPEC_NONE, or not a type)
 258+ C150 11 6F C1             ld de,spec_types
 259+ C153 ED 32                add de,a
 260+ C155 1A                   ld a,(de)
 261+ C156 32 A4 C7             ld (sp_type),a                  ; its record type (ZT_*)
 262+ C159 3E 05                ld a,LV_SPECIAL-LV_SPECIAL_ID
 263+ C15B ED 31                add hl,a
 264+ C15D 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; how many
 265+ C15E 32 A6 C7             ld (sp_left),a
 266+ C161 CD 74 C1             call spec_place
 267+ C164 2A A7 C7     .ns:    ld hl,(sw_ptr)
 268+ C167 23                   inc hl
 269+ C168 22 A7 C7             ld (sw_ptr),hl
 270+ C16B C1                   pop bc
 271+ C16C 10 D9                djnz .sl
 272+ C16E C9                   ret
 273+ C16F
 274+ C16F              ; Special type (SPEC_*, the level files) -> record type (ZT_*)
 275+ C16F 04 05 02 03  spec_types: db ZT_GHOST, ZT_BANSHEE, ZT_GHOUL, ZT_LICH, ZT_DEVIL
 275+ C173 06
 276+ C174                      ASSERT $ - spec_types == SPEC_IDS
 277+ C174                      ASSERT SPEC_GHOST == 0 && SPEC_BANSHEE == 1 && SPEC_GHOUL == 2
 278+ C174                      ASSERT SPEC_LICH == 3 && SPEC_DEVIL == 4
 279+ C174
 280+ C174              ; sp_left monsters of record type sp_type into free special records (as
 281+ C174              ; many as there's room for)
 282+ C174              spec_place:
 283+ C174 DD 21 06 30          ld ix,zombies+NZOMB*ZREC
 284+ C178 06 08                ld b,NSPEC

 291+ C187 C5                   push bc

 293+ C189 32 A5 C7             ld (sp_idx),a
 294+ C18C 21 50 2A             ld hl,zatk_flags

 296+ C191 36 00                ld (hl),FALSE
 297+ C193 DD 36 0E 00          ld (ix+14),0                    ; no blip yet

 301+ C19E FE 03                cp ZT_LICH
 302+ C1A0 28 14                jr z,.li
 303+ C1A2 FE 02                cp ZT_GHOUL
 304+ C1A4 28 16                jr z,.gh

 370+ C220              ; Special monster IX's settings, from its type (+15): g_speed (8.8 units a
 371+ C220              ; frame: a ghost twice the zombies' zspeed, a banshee four times), gp_range
 372+ C220              ; (its reach on each axis), gp_dmg (a blow), gp_base (1: attacks the base)
 373+ C220              g_params:

 375+ C223 6F                   ld l,a
 376+ C224 26 00                ld h,0

 378+ C227 29                   add hl,hl
 379+ C228 29                   add hl,hl

 389+ C23D 32 A2 C7             ld (gp_dmg),a

 391+ C241 32 A3 C7             ld (gp_base),a

 393+ C245 29           .b:     add hl,hl                       ; a banshee: twice as fast

 395+ C249 21 80 00             ld hl,BANSHEE_R

 400+ C256 32 A3 C7             ld (gp_base),a
 401+ C259 C9                   ret
 402+ C25A
 403+ C25A              ; Killed (zdamage): it hangs where it is, fading out (zombie_draw colours
 404+ C25A              ; it by the frames left), then is gone
 405+ C25A              g_dying:
 406+ C25A DD 35 11             dec (ix+17)
 407+ C25D C0                   ret nz
 408+ C25E DD 36 0A 00          ld (ix+10),0                    ; gone (zflags unmarks its cell)
 409+ C262 C9                   ret
 410+ C263
 411+ C263              ; Decision check: look for a human or the VTOL to chase
 412+ C263              g_decide:
 413+ C263 CD 30 C5             call g_find                     ; carry: a target, at gt_x/z/y
 414+ C266 30 0B                jr nc,.none
 415+ C268 DD 36 10 01          ld (ix+16),GM_CHASE

 422+ C27C                      ; lost it (gone, or out of sight): roam again, a new direction
 423+ C27C DD 36 10 00  g_lose: ld (ix+16),GM_ROAM
 424+ C280 DD 36 0B 1E          ld (ix+11),GHOST_DECIDE
 425+ C284 DD 36 1E FF          ld (ix+30),TG_NONE
 426+ C288                      ; fall through
 427+ C288
 428+ C288              ; A random direction: velocity g_speed at a random angle, and a random climb
 429+ C288              ; (-1, 0, +1, 0 units a frame)
 430+ C288              g_random:
 431+ C288 CD A2 27             call zrand
 432+ C28B E5                   push hl
 433+ C28C 7D                   ld a,l
 434+ C28D F5                   push af

   1++C7D3              ;==============================================================================
   2++C7D3              ; Z-POLICE - the final boss: the devil (in the special monsters' page,
   3++C7D3              ; PAGE_SPECIAL, at $C000 in slot 6: specials.asm includes it)
   4++C7D3              ;
   5++C7D3              ; Quatermass's horned Martian, ten building levels tall (DEVIL_H, 46 m) and a
   6++C7D3              ; whole square wide, in the last wave of the last level (the level files:
   7++C7D3              ; SPEC_DEVIL, alone).  It rises at the entrance to hell (HELL_X, HELL_Z: a
   8++C7D3              ; circle of road the level's map changes make) or, if that isn't road, on a
   9++C7D3              ; street at random (zplace).  A special monster record (zombie.asm), type
  10++C7D3              ; ZT_DEVIL; drawn by devil_draw (city2.asm) from its own graphics, which go
  11++C7D3              ; over the other monsters' pages when its wave starts (wave_prepare,
  12++C7D3              ; devil_load: only the zombies and humans are drawn with it).
  13++C7D3              ;   * It walks the streets to the landing pad, half a tile a step
  14++C7D3              ;     (DV_STEP_FR frames each: moving for DV_MOVE_FR, then planted), every
  15++C7D3              ;     footfall shaking the view.  At a cell's middle it takes the way that
  16++C7D3              ;     brings it nearest the pad (not back the way it came unless it must);
  17++C7D3              ;     a terrace or pad tile it steps onto is crushed (base_damage: the pad,
  18++C7D3              ;     game over).
  19++C7D3              ;   * Its eyes charge, black to blue, wherever the VTOL is, for
  20++C7D3              ;     DV_CHARGE_T interrupts (10 s; a rising whine for the last DV_HUM_T,
  21++C7D3              ;     3 s: SFX_CHARGE), then it fires lightning (a crackling zap and
  22++C7D3              ;     thunder: SFX_BOLT): straight at the
  23++C7D3              ;     VTOL, instantly, through anything in the way.  A building the bolt
  24++C7D3              ;     passes below the roof of comes down (dv_topple: DV_PARTS particles,
  25++C7D3              ;     falling 1 m every 2 frames to RUBBLE_H; the humans on it killed; the
  26++C7D3              ;     map in memory only).  The VTOL takes BOLT_DMG, spins 15-90 degrees
  27++C7D3              ;     either way (spin_rate, spin_t: player.asm), is pitched full up or
  28++C7D3              ;     down, and is braked to a stop as the air brake does (bolt_brake).
  29++C7D3              ;     Then DV_REST_T interrupts (2 s) before it charges again.
  30++C7D3              ;   * DEVIL_HP hit points (16 bits, as a lich's: +18 and LICH_HP_HI); its
  31++C7D3              ;     hit box DEVIL_HIT_R either side, DEVIL_H tall (weapons.asm).  Killed,
  32++C7D3              ;     it sinks into the ground over DV_DIE_FR frames in fire, then it's gone.
  33++C7D3              ; Its record, besides the zombies' fields: +4 heading (0 +z, 1 +x, 2 -z,
  34++C7D3              ; 3 -x), +5 its legs' frame, +7 1: stuck (nowhere to go), +11 the frame in
  35++C7D3              ; its step, +16 mode (0 walking, GM_DYING), +17 frames left sinking,
  36++C7D3              ; +21,+22 its feet (below the ground as it sinks), DV_EYES (0 resting,
  37++C7D3              ; 1 charging) and DV_T0 (game_now when that began).
  38++C7D3              ;==============================================================================
  39++C7D3
  40++C7D3              DEVIL_HP        equ 10
  41++C7D3              DV_STEP_FR      equ 24              ; frames a step
  42++C7D3              DV_MOVE_FR      equ 16              ; moving for this many of them
  43++C7D3              DV_STEP_U       equ TILE_UNITS/2/DV_MOVE_FR     ; units a frame (half a tile a step)
  44++C7D3                      ASSERT DV_STEP_U * DV_MOVE_FR == TILE_UNITS/2
  45++C7D3              DV_RANGE        equ 8*TILE_UNITS    ; it fires at the VTOL this near (160 m)
  46++C7D3              DV_CHARGE_T     equ 500             ; interrupts charging (10 s),
  47++C7D3              DV_HUM_T        equ 150             ;   the last of them whining (3 s: SFX_CHARGE)
  48++C7D3              DV_REST_T       equ 100             ; and resting after a shot (2 s)
  49++C7D3              BOLT_DMG        equ 10
  50++C7D3              ; The storm after its death (dv_storm): STORM_T ticks of lightning from
  51++C7D3              ; where it sank, into the sky and at the buildings around (within
  52++C7D3              ; STORM_R cells each way: they come down), NSTORM bolts at most at once,
  53++C7D3              ; a new one every STORM_GAP..STORM_GAP+3 ticks at first, slowing as it
  54++C7D3              ; goes (+1 tick each 16 ticks of it: about 35 at the end), each drawn
  55++C7D3              ; STORM_BOLT_T; the view shaking all through, a jolt at each
  56++C7D3              STORM_T         equ 500             ; 10 s
  57++C7D3              STORM_R         equ 4
  58++C7D3              STORM_GAP       equ 4
  59++C7D3              STORM_BOLT_T    equ 10

  61++C7D3              BOLT_FRAMES     equ (4*FT_N+ASSUMED_FPS)/FT_D   ; ticks the bolt is drawn
  62++C7D3                                                  ; (4 frames: 14)
  63++C7D3              DV_EYE_H        equ DEVIL_H*108/DEVIL_SRC_H     ; its eyes' height (row 20)
  64++C7D3              DV_DIE_FR       equ 40              ; frames sinking, killed
  65++C7D3              DEVIL_HIT_R     equ 100             ; its hit box: this far either side (8 m),
  66++C7D3              DEVIL_AIM_H     equ 240             ;   DEVIL_H tall; the guns' aim: its chest
  67++C7D3                      ASSERT DEVIL_HIT_R < 255 && DEVIL_AIM_H < 256
  68++C7D3              DV_SINK         equ DEVIL_H/DV_DIE_FR+1         ; units a frame, dying
  69++C7D3              DV_PARTS        equ 50              ; a building brought down: its particles
  70++C7D3              DV_TALL         equ 5               ; it walks through buildings under level 5
  71++C7D3              DV_TREAD_PARTS  equ 6               ; a zombie trodden on: its burst
  72++C7D3              DV_KILL_PARTS   equ 2               ; each monster dying with it: its burst
  73++C7D3              DV_DARK_HP      equ 100             ; its hit points a darker step
  74++C7D3              DV_DIE_PARTS    equ 4               ; dying: fire every other frame
  75++C7D3              SPIN_FR         equ 32              ; ticks the VTOL's spin takes (0.64 s;
  76++C7D3                                                  ; 256/SPIN_FR whole: spin_rate)
  77++C7D3              SPIN_MIN        equ 5               ; 7 degrees (256 a turn)
  78++C7D3              SPIN_RANGE      equ 27              ; .. up to 44 (31)
  79++C7D3              PITCH_KICK      equ PMAX/2          ; the nose up or down this much (17 degrees)
  80++C7D3              DV_EYES         equ 24              ; record: its eyes (0 resting, 1 charging),
  81++C7D3              DV_T0           equ 25              ;   game_now when that began (2)
  82++C7D3                      ASSERT DV_T0+1 < 31 && LICH_HP_HI != DV_EYES && LICH_HP_HI != DV_T0

   1+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 2000              ; Z-POLICE - zombie page (8K page PAGE_ZOMBIE, mapped at $2000 in MMU slot 1)
   3+ 2000              ;
   4+ 2000              ; Placeholder zombies: Layer 2 stick-man silhouettes walking the streets.
   5+ 2000              ; The page stays mapped at $2000 the whole time (slot 0 is used for paging
   6+ 2000              ; Layer 2 sections, slot 7 for the other code pages), so the city page can
   7+ 2000              ; call in here while it draws.
   8+ 2000              ;
   9+ 2000              ; Each zombie is a ZREC-byte record:
  10+ 2000              ;   +0,+1  x  8.8 fixed point in cell units (high byte = cell, low = fraction;
  11+ 2000              ;             the same as world units, one cell = 256)
  12+ 2000              ;   +2,+3  z  likewise
  13+ 2000              ;   +4     heading 0 = +z, 1 = +x, 2 = -z, 3 = -x  (yaw angle = heading*64;
  14+ 2000              ;             heading+1 turns right, heading+3 turns left)
  15+ 2000              ;   +5     walk animation phase 0..3
  16+ 2000              ;   +6     step accumulator: fraction of a world unit (4 bits)
  17+ 2000              ;   +7     wait: frames left standing still (0 = walking)
  18+ 2000              ;   +8,+9  cell (x, z) of the last turn decision ($FF = none)
  19+ 2000              ;   +10    active: 1 = in play, 0 = gone (not moved, linked or drawn)
  20+ 2000              ;   +11    frames until this zombie's next decision check
  21+ 2000              ;   +12,+13  cell (x, z) of its blip on the street map
  22+ 2000              ;   +14    1 = blip plotted
  23+ 2000              ;   +15    type: 0 = zombie, 1 = fast zombie (walks at twice the speed),
  24+ 2000              ;          ZT_GHOUL (a special: 5x, half height), ZT_LICH (a special: 4x,
  25+ 2000              ;          twice the height), ZT_GHOST, ZT_BANSHEE
  26+ 2000              ;   +16    mode: 0 = walking, 1 = going for a base tile, 2 = attacking it
  27+ 2000              ;   +17    frames to its next hit on the tile
  28+ 2000              ;   +18    hit points left (ZHP, ZHP_FAST; weapons.asm zdamage)
  29+ 2000              ;   +19,+20  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_ZOMBIE in city_map ($FF = none)
  30+ 2000              ;   +21,+22  height of its feet (0 for zombies; special monsters fly)
  31+ 2000              ;   +23..+30 special monsters' own fields (specials.asm)
  32+ 2000              ;   +31    bit 0: drawn last frame (fig_seen; moved to bit 1 by lk_clear,
  33+ 2000              ;          weapons.asm); bit 1: so, once the missile lock has used bit 0, for
  34+ 2000              ;          the guns (aim_assist)
  35+ 2000              ;   +32,+33  where: the centre column and row on the view (the missile lock)
  36+ 2000              ; Records 0..NZOMB-1 are the zombies, NZOMB..NMON-1 the special monsters
  37+ 2000              ; (specials.asm), which share the drawing, cell marks, map blips and weapon
  38+ 2000              ; hits; their type (+15) says which.
  39+ 2000              ; zatk_flags (one byte per zombie, by index): TRUE while it attacks a base
  40+ 2000              ; tile, when its map dot is red; FALSE again once the tile is destroyed.
  41+ 2000              ;
  42+ 2000              ; The base: at junctions a zombie leans towards the road that points at the
  43+ 2000              ; landing pad (zbias_t, from the level).  A base tile (terrace or pad) in its
  44+ 2000              ; way isn't avoided: it walks up to ATTACK_R from it and hits it every
  45+ 2000              ; ZHIT_FRAMES frames.  A destroyed terrace tile becomes road and the zombie
  46+ 2000              ; walks on; the pad destroyed sets game_over.
  47+ 2000              ;
  48+ 2000              ; Street map blips: zblip / zblip_off (map.asm) are called on the zombie's
  49+ 2000              ; decision-check frames.  Call zblip_off for a zombie before making it gone.
  50+ 2000              ;
  51+ 2000              ; Decisions are taken one record a frame: zdec_i steps through the records
  52+ 2000              ; (0..NMON-1, round: zombies, then the special records, where ghouls and a
  53+ 2000              ; lich walk too), and only the record it points at decides this frame (an
  54+ 2000              ; empty one: nobody does).  So each walker decides once every NMON frames.
  55+ 2000              ; A decision: its map blip moves, junctions (zjunction), and a look-ahead
  56+ 2000              ; for a building or the map edge (zlook: ZMARGIN + zsteps frames of
  57+ 2000              ; walking; a smart turn, towards the pad, or a dead end's wait).
  58+ 2000              ; Between decisions every step is checked (zmove .step): a step that would
  59+ 2000              ; take it within ZMARGIN of the next cell, when that cell isn't a street,
  60+ 2000              ; isn't taken.  A base tile there: it goes for it (zattack); else it stops
  61+ 2000              ; and turns 90 degrees, left or right at random (zturn).  Crossing into a
  62+ 2000              ; new cell moves its map blip too.
  63+ 2000              ;
  64+ 2000              ; Movement (zmove), every frame:
  65+ 2000              ;   * Standing still: count the wait down and do nothing else.
  66+ 2000              ;   * Not this zombie's check frame: step forwards (see the last point).
  67+ 2000              ;   * Junctions: once per cell, when the zombie is 0.25-0.75 of the way
  68+ 2000              ;     through the cell along its heading, look for a road (street cell) to
  69+ 2000              ;     the left and to the right.  Left is tested first: if there is a road,
  70+ 2000              ;     turn left at random (1 in 2); if not taken, the same for the right.
  71+ 2000              ;     The cell is then marked as decided, so it isn't tested again until the
  72+ 2000              ;     zombie has been somewhere else.
  73+ 2000              ;   * Blocked (building or map edge within zlook ahead): turn left if there
  74+ 2000              ;     is a road there, else right; otherwise turn round and stand still for
  75+ 2000              ;     ZWAIT frames before testing anything again.
  76+ 2000              ;   * Otherwise step forwards zspeed/16 world units (the remainder is kept,
  77+ 2000              ;     so slow speeds still move smoothly on average).
  78+ 2000              ;
  79+ 2000              ; Zombies are only ever on street (empty) cells.  They are drawn by the city
  80+ 2000              ; traversal when it reaches their cell (draw_cell jumps to zombie_cell for
  81+ 2000              ; empty cells), so the painter's algorithm hides them behind nearer buildings.
  82+ 2000              ; A cell holding zombies has bit 7 (CELL_ZOMBIE) of its city_map byte set,
  83+ 2000              ; by zflags every frame; zombie_cell then searches the records for them.
  84+ 2000              ;
  85+ 2000              ; Sprites (tables_zombie.inc, generated): 8 scales from 1x4 to 8x16 pixels,
  86+ 2000              ; forward and left facings, 4 walk frames.  Rear and right are the mirrored
  87+ 2000              ; forward and left.  One byte per row, bit 7 = leftmost pixel.
  88+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
  89+ 2000
  90+ 2000              NZOMB           equ 40          ; zombie records: the most in a wave
  91+ 2000              NSPEC           equ 8           ; most special monsters (5 ghosts, banshees)
  92+ 2000              NMON            equ NZOMB+NSPEC ; records: zombies, then special monsters
  93+ 2000              ZREC            equ 34          ; bytes per record
  94+ 2000              ZT_FAST         equ 1           ; +15: fast zombie
  95+ 2000              ZT_GHOUL        equ 2           ; +15: a ghoul: a special monster that walks
  96+ 2000                                              ; as a zombie (zmove), half height, 5x speed
  97+ 2000              ZT_LICH         equ 3           ; +15: a lich, a city's boss: a special
  98+ 2000                                              ; monster that walks as a zombie (zmove),
  99+ 2000                                              ; twice the height, 4x speed; it shoots
 100+ 2000                                              ; fireballs (lich_update, weapons.asm)
 101+ 2000              ZT_GHOST        equ 4           ; +15: a ghost (specials.asm); types from
 102+ 2000              ZT_BANSHEE      equ 5           ; here on fly (specials.asm moves them)
 103+ 2000              ZT_DEVIL        equ 6           ; +15: the final boss (devil.asm), drawn by
 104+ 2000                                              ; devil_draw (city2.asm)
 105+ 2000              ZHP             equ 5           ; hit points: a zombie (level 1)
 106+ 2000              ZHP_FAST        equ 4           ; and a fast zombie
 107+ 2000              GHOUL_HP        equ ZHP         ; and a ghoul
 108+ 2000              ZSPEED_INIT     equ 10          ; starting zspeed: 0.63 units (4.9 cm) per
 109+ 2000                                              ; frame, ~0.7 m/s at 14 fps
 110+ 2000              ZSTEPS_INIT     equ 10          ; zsteps: a decision looks 10 frames' walk
 111+ 2000                                              ; ahead (decisions: one record a frame,
 112+ 2000                                              ; zdec_i)
 113+ 2000              ZMARGIN         equ 16          ; keep at least this far from walls: 1.25 m
 114+ 2000              ZC_TRIES        equ 16          ; zcluster: places to try near the parent
 115+ 2000              ZC_R            equ 2*TILE_UNITS ;  within 2 tiles of it on x and z
 116+ 2000                      ASSERT 383+128 <= ZC_R          ; (zc_axis)
 117+ 2000              ZWAIT           equ 100         ; frames' worth to stand still when stuck
 118+ 2000              ZOMBIE_H        equ 26          ; height: 2 m (the same as the hit box, ZHIT_H)
 119+ 2000              GHOUL_H         equ ZOMBIE_H/2  ; a ghoul's height: 1 m
 120+ 2000              LICH_H          equ 2*ZOMBIE_H  ; a lich's height: 4 m
 121+ 2000                      ASSERT LICH_H == FIG_LICH_H     ; (gfx_ids.inc)
 122+ 2000                      ASSERT ZSPEED_INIT*5+15 < 256   ; a ghoul's step (zcalc_step) fits
 123+ 2000

 156+ 2037              ; A wave: the level's LV_ZOMBIES zombies (level_cur; at most NZOMB), LV_FAST

 159+ 2037              ; records' cell marks, +19 / +20, are left to zflags: a zombie killed this

 904+ 2593              ; Barricades: terrace tiles away from the base, improvised barricades.  Each
 905+ 2593              ; has its own hit points, in barr_tab (resident): NBARR entries of BARR_REC

 907+ 2593              ; at the level's start from the city map (after the level's map changes),

 909+ 2593              ; blasts damage them through base_damage (zbase: any terrace tile is a base

   1+ 313C              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 313C              ; Z-POLICE - humans to rescue (in the zombie page, after zombie.asm: kept
   3+ 313C              ; mapped in slot 1)
   4+ 313C              ;
   5+ 313C              ; Up to HUMAN_MAX humans, nhumans of them placed at random at start-up (on a
   6+ 313C              ; road, or on a roof low enough to land on).  They stand facing the player,
   7+ 313C              ; and wave their right arm while the VTOL is within WAVE_R.  On the city map
   8+ 313C              ; each is a blue dot, flashing 3 frames on, 3 off.
   9+ 313C              ;
  10+ 313C              ; Fleeing (hum_flee): a human on the road (never one on a roof) with a
  11+ 313C              ; monster within FLEE_R runs from the nearest one for FLEE_TIME frames, at
  12+ 313C              ; HUMAN_FLEE units a frame, then looks again.  Its way is picked at random
  13+ 313C              ; of the two that take it away from the monster (along x or along z); if
  14+ 313C              ; that way is blocked (a building, the base, the wall) it takes the other,
  15+ 313C              ; and if both are, it stands.  It only runs along roads.
  16+ 313C              ;
  17+ 313C              ; Base: landed on the landing pad (map code PAD_CODE), the passengers get off
  18+ 313C              ; one every DISEMBARK frames (a second) and are counted as saved.
  19+ 313C              ;
  20+ 313C              ; Rescue: when the craft has landed (speed 0, resting on the road or on the
  21+ 313C              ; roof under it), carries fewer than PASSENGER_MAX and a human stands within
  22+ 313C              ; RESCUE_R at the same height (a roof of the same height, or the road), the
  23+ 313C              ; human runs to it at HUMAN_RUN units a frame and climbs in.  A human on a
  24+ 313C              ; taller or lower roof cannot be reached.
  25+ 313C              ;
  26+ 313C              ; Each human is an HREC-byte record:
  27+ 313C              ;   +0,+1  x  (world units: high byte = cell, as for zombies)
  28+ 313C              ;   +2,+3  z
  29+ 313C              ;   +4,+5  y  height of its feet (roof height, or 0 on the road)
  30+ 313C              ;   +6     state (HS_*): 0 unused, 1 waiting in the city, 2 aboard the
  31+ 313C              ;          VTOL, 3 rescued (off at the landing pad), 4 dead
  32+ 313C              ;   +7,+8  cell (x, z) of its map dot
  33+ 313C              ;   +9     1 = map dot shown
  34+ 313C              ;   +10    hit points left (HUMAN_HP; a rocket blast, weapons.asm)
  35+ 313C              ;   +11,+12  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_HUMAN in city_map ($FF = none)
  36+ 313C              ;   +13    how it's drawn this frame: 0 standing, HUM_WAVING waving, or
  37+ 313C              ;          running (to the VTOL, or fleeing): its way + 1 (1 +z, 2 +x,
  38+ 313C              ;          3 -z, 4 -x, as a zombie's heading + 1)
  39+ 313C              ;   +14    fleeing: frames left (0: not fleeing)
  40+ 313C              ;   +15    fleeing: its way + 1 (as +13)
  41+ 313C              ;
  42+ 313C              ; Drawing: draw_cell (city page) tests the cell's CELL_HUMAN mark in
  43+ 313C              ; city_map (bit 6, set by hum_flags) and draws them with human_cell: after
  44+ 313C              ; the building on whose roof they stand, so the roof doesn't cover them.  With
  45+ 313C              ; OCCLUSION_CULL the cell goes on the draw list instead (as its city_col
  46+ 313C              ; address, $6000-$6FFF) and is drawn from there.
  47+ 313C              ;==============================================================================
  48+ 313C
  49+ 313C              HREC            equ 16
  50+ 313C              HUM_WAVING      equ 5               ; +13: waving (above the 4 ways)
  51+ 313C              HS_NONE         equ 0               ; human states (+6)
  52+ 313C              HS_WAIT         equ 1               ; waiting in the city to be rescued
  53+ 313C              HS_ABOARD       equ 2               ; aboard the VTOL
  54+ 313C              HS_SAVED        equ 3               ; rescued: off at the landing pad
  55+ 313C              HS_DEAD         equ 4               ; killed (a rocket blast, a ghost)
  56+ 313C
  57+ 313C
  58+ 313C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  59+ 313C              ; Place nhumans humans at random: on a road cell, or on a roof of level
  60+ 313C              ; no taller than HUMAN_ROOF_MAX, never on the perimeter wall.

   2+ 3805              ; Z-POLICE - city map (in the zombie page, after human.asm: kept mapped in
   3+ 3805              ; slot 1)
   4+ 3805              ;
   5+ 3805              ; Everything that draws the GRID x GRID city map at the right of the
   6+ 3805              ; instrument panel (pixel columns MAP_X.., rows 128-191, one pixel per cell,
   7+ 3805              ; north up):
   8+ 3805              ;   * map_init / map_l2: the map itself, drawn once at start-up into both
   9+ 3805              ;     Layer 2 buffers, and the ULA set-up over it (called from ula_init);
  10+ 3805              ;   * map_player: the player's flashing white dot, on the ULA (draw_hud);
  11+ 3805              ;   * zblip / zblip_off: zombie blips, bright green (zombie.asm, weapons.asm);
  12+ 3805              ;   * hum_dots / hum_dot: humans' flashing blue dots (human.asm);
  13+ 3805              ;   * map_pix / map_under: set one map cell's pixel in both Layer 2 buffers,
  14+ 3805              ;     and the colour the map itself has there.
  15+ 3805              ; Page 7 is always mapped, so all the pages above can call in here.
  16+ 3805              ;==============================================================================
  17+ 3805
  18+ 3805              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  19+ 3805              ; City map: GRID x GRID cells at one pixel each (64x64), north up, at pixel
  20+ 3805              ; columns MAP_X.. and rows 128-191.  It is drawn on Layer 2, into both
  21+ 3805              ; buffers once (the viewport clear only touches rows 0-127), so each
  22+ 3805              ; building can be its own colour; zombie blips and human dots are written
  23+ 3805              ; into it too.  The ULA above it is transparent paper with white ink for the
  24+ 3805              ; player's flashing dot.

 131+ 38AB              ; Zombie blips: each zombie is one bright green (MAP_ZOMBIE) pixel at its cell,

2818  39C1                      DISPLAY "Map end:   ",/A,$
2819  39C1                      INCLUDE "interrupts.asm"        ; IM 2 vector table and routine
# file opened: interrupts.asm
   1+ 39C1              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 39C1              ; Z-POLICE - interrupt mode 2 (in the zombie page, after map.asm: kept
   3+ 39C1              ; mapped in slot 1, so the table and routine are there whatever page is
   4+ 39C1              ; swapped in; the ROM replaces slot 1 only during esxDOS calls, when
   5+ 39C1              ; interrupts are off)
   6+ 39C1              ;
   7+ 39C1              ; In IM 2 an interrupt calls the address held in the word at I*256 + the
   8+ 39C1              ; byte on the data bus, which can be anything.  So:
   9+ 39C1              ;   * im2_table is 256 words, every one the address of im2_routine, at a
  10+ 39C1              ;     256-byte boundary (I holds the high byte of its address): any bus
  11+ 39C1              ;     byte, even $FF (bytes $FF and $100), reads a word inside it;
  12+ 39C1              ;   * an odd bus byte reads a word that straddles two entries, low byte
  13+ 39C1              ;     from one and high byte from the next, so im2_routine sits at an
  14+ 39C1              ;     address whose high and low bytes are the same (IM2_ROUTINE, $xyxy):
  15+ 39C1              ;     read either way round, it's the same address.
  16+ 39C1              ; im2_init sets I and IM 2 (start calls it after init_audio); start enables
  17+ 39C1              ; interrupts just before the main menu, and they stay on, 50 a second, except:
  18+ 39C1              ;   * over esxDOS calls (fh_rom_in / fh_rom_out): the ROM covers slot 1, this
  19+ 39C1              ;     page, so they are off and put back as they were;
  20+ 39C1              ;   * the span filler borrows SP (city.asm: PUSHes into Layer 2, slot 0).  An
  21+ 39C1              ;     interrupt there pushes its return address just below SP: into the
  22+ 39C1              ;     part of the span still to be filled, which the PUSHes then overwrite.
  23+ 39C1              ;     Interrupts are off from just before a span's last PUSH until SP is
  24+ 39C1              ;     back (push_blk), and a 1-pixel span doesn't borrow SP at all.
  25+ 39C1              ; The routine switches to its own stack at once, keeps every register, and
  26+ 39C1              ; touches the AY ports only while the engines are on (eng_on): code outside
  27+ 39C1              ; the interrupt writes the AY chips only with eng_on 0 (init_audio,
  28+ 39C1              ; engine_start).  Then it also borrows slot 7 for the sound page, and the
  29+ 39C1              ; NextReg ports ($243B, $253B) to find what's there: both put back as they
  30+ 39C1              ; were (the selected NextReg too).
  31+ 39C1              ;==============================================================================
  32+ 39C1
  33+ 39C1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  34+ 39C1              ; Point I at the vector table and select interrupt mode 2.  (start enables
  35+ 39C1              ; interrupts later.)
  36+ 39C1              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  53+ 3C3C
  54+ 3C3C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  55+ 3C3C              ; The interrupt routine, each video frame (50 a second): a tick counted
  56+ 3C3C              ; (isr_ticks), and with the engines on (eng_on), the engines' sound
  57+ 3C3C              ; (engine_tick) and the sound effects (sfx_tick): in the audio page
  58+ 3C3C              ; (sound.asm), mapped into slot 7 meanwhile and the page there put back
  59+ 3C3C              ; after.  The page there is read through the NextReg ports, so the main
  60+ 3C3C              ; code's selected NextReg ($243B, which it may have set and not yet read
  61+ 3C3C              ; or written through $253B) is read first and put back last.  On its own stack: SP may
  62+ 3C3C              ; be the span filler's.  It must never use the alternate registers (EXX,
  63+ 3C3C              ; EX AF,AF'): the city's cell walks keep their place in HL', DE' across
  64+ 3C3C              ; the whole drawing (draw_row, city.asm).
  65+ 3C3C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ 3C3C              im2_routine:
  67+ 3C3C ED 73 9B 3C          ld (isr_sp),sp                  ; its own stack at once (no PUSH on
  68+ 3C40 31 BF 3C             ld sp,isr_stack                 ; a borrowed one)
  69+ 3C43 F5                   push af
  70+ 3C44 C5                   push bc
  71+ 3C45 D5                   push de
  72+ 3C46 E5                   push hl
  73+ 3C47 2A 9D 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)               ; the frames counted (wave_prepare)
  74+ 3C4A 23                   inc hl
  75+ 3C4B 22 9D 3C             ld (isr_ticks),hl
  76+ 3C4E 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)                   ; nothing to play: the AYs alone
  77+ 3C51 B7                   or a
  78+ 3C52 28 2A                jr z,.out
  79+ 3C54 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; the NextReg the main code has
  80+ 3C57 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; selected (it may be between its OUT
  81+ 3C59 32 99 3C             ld (isr_sel),a                  ; and its IN): put back after
  82+ 3C5C 3E 57                ld a,CODE_MMU                   ; slot 7's page, to put back after
  83+ 3C5E ED 79                out (c),a
  84+ 3C60 04                   inc b
  85+ 3C61 ED 78                in a,(c)
  86+ 3C63 32 9A 3C             ld (isr_mmu7),a

2840  0200                      MMU SPRBANK_SLOT e, PAGE_SPR0, SPRBANK_ADDR

# file opened: sprite_data.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - sprite pattern banks (8K pages, assembled at $E000)
   3+ E000              ;
   4+ E000              ; Hardware sprite patterns are only needed when they are loaded into the
   5+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory, so they live in their own pages, out of the way,
   6+ E000              ; each with its own loader so that no resident memory is used:
   7+ E000              ;
   8+ E000              ;       nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPR0      ; the bank into slot 7
   9+ E000              ;       call spr_load_bank              ; copy its patterns
  10+ E000              ;
  11+ E000              ; Call it from outside slot 7 (resident code or a game logic page in slot
  12+ E000              ; 6), and page back whatever slot 7 had afterwards if it is still needed.
  13+ E000              ; spr_load_bank is the same address ($E000) in every bank.
  14+ E000              ;
  15+ E000              ; Each bank (SPRBANK_ADDR = $E000):
  16+ E000              ;   +0          spr_load_bank: the loader (SPRB_LOADER), the same in each
  17+ E000              ;   SPRB_COUNT  number of patterns (1..31: 256 bytes each, 8-bit 16x16)
  18+ E000              ;   SPRB_FIRST  the pattern number the first one loads to (0..63)
  19+ E000              ;   SPRB_DATA   the patterns, one after another
  20+ E000              ; More sprites: add a bank (the next free page, its own PAGE_SPRn in
  21+ E000              ; memory_bank_defs.asm, the MMU / ORG lines in zpolice.asm and a block here
  22+ E000              ; starting with SPRB_LOADER).
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              ; Copy this bank's patterns into the sprite pattern memory.  Runs from the
  26+ E000              ; bank itself: reads only, so it needs no variables.
  27+ E000                      MACRO SPRB_LOADER
  28+ E000 ~                    ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_FIRST)  ; from this pattern
  29+ E000 ~                    ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
  30+ E000 ~                    out (c),a
  31+ E000 ~                    ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_COUNT)
  32+ E000 ~                    ld d,a
  33+ E000 ~                    ld hl,SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_DATA
  34+ E000 ~                    ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT
  35+ E000 ~            .lp:    ld b,0                          ; 256 bytes a pattern
  36+ E000 ~                    otir
  37+ E000 ~                    dec d
  38+ E000 ~                    jr nz,.lp
  39+ E000 ~                    ret
  40+ E000                      ENDM
  41+ E000
  42+ E000              spr_load_bank   equ SPRBANK_ADDR        ; the loader, in every bank
  43+ E000              SPRB_COUNT      equ spr_bank0_hdr-spr_bank0
  44+ E000              SPRB_FIRST      equ SPRB_COUNT+1
  45+ E000              SPRB_DATA       equ SPRB_COUNT+2
  46+ E000
  47+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ E000              ; Bank 0 (PAGE_SPR0): the human status sprites (patterns 0-3), then the
  49+ E000              ; compass bar's letters, dots and pointer (CSPR_*, hud_sprites.asm)
  50+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm maps PAGE_SPR0 to SPRBANK_SLOT, ORG SPRBANK_ADDR, first)
  51+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  53+ E003 01 3B 30    >        ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
